title.zh: 卷331 列傳一百十八 海兰察子 安禄 奎林 珠勒格德 和隆武 额森特 普尔普
title.en: Volume 331 Biographies 118: Hai Lan Cha Zi, An Lu, Kui Lin, Zhu Lei Ge De, He Longwu, E Sen Te, Pu Er Pu
title.raw: 卷331 列傳一百十八 海兰察子 安禄 奎林 珠勒格德 和隆武 额森特 普尔普

sentences.zh: 列傳一百十八

translations.literal: Biography One Hundred Eighteen
translations.idiomatic: Biography 118

sentences.zh: 海蘭察子安祿奎林珠勒格德和隆武額森特普爾普

translations.literal: Hai Lancha, his son Anlu, Kuilin, Zhulegede, Helongwu, Esente, and Pu'erpu
translations.idiomatic: Hai Lancha; his son Anlu; Kuilin; Zhulegede; Helongwu; Esente; and Pu'erpu

sentences.zh: 海蘭察，多拉爾氏，滿洲鑲黃旗人，世居黑龍江。

translations.literal: Hai Lancha, of the Doral clan, a Manchu of the Bordered Yellow Banner, his family having long resided in Heilongjiang.
translations.idiomatic: Hai Lancha, of the Doral clan, was a Manchu of the Bordered Yellow Banner whose family had long lived in Heilongjiang.

sentences.zh: 乾隆二十年，以索倫馬甲從征準噶爾。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year of the Qianlong reign, as a Solon armored cavalryman he followed the campaign against the Dzungars.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year of the Qianlong reign, he served as a Solon armored cavalryman in the campaign against the Dzungars.

sentences.zh: 輝特台吉巴雅爾既降，復從阿睦爾撒納叛，師索之急，遁入塔爾巴哈台山中，海蘭察力追及之，射墜馬，生獲以歸，敘功，賜號額爾克巴圖魯。

translations.literal: The Khoid Taiji Bayar having submitted, again followed Amursana in rebellion; the army pursued him urgently; he fled into the Tarbagatai mountains. Hai Lancha vigorously pursued and caught up, shot him from his horse, captured him alive and returned. Recording merit, he was granted the title Erike Baturu.
translations.idiomatic: After the Khoid Taiji Bayar had submitted and then rebelled again alongside Amursana, the army pursued him hotly until he fled into the Tarbagatai Mountains. Hai Lancha pressed hard, caught up with him, shot him from his horse, and brought him back alive. For this feat he was granted the baturu title Erike Baturu.

sentences.zh: 累擢頭等侍衛，予騎都尉兼雲騎尉世職，圖形紫光閣。

translations.literal: Repeatedly promoted to First Class Imperial Bodyguard; granted the hereditary office of Cavalry Commandant concurrently with Cloud Cavalry Captain; his portrait placed in the Hall of Purple Splendor.
translations.idiomatic: He was repeatedly promoted to first-class imperial bodyguard and granted the hereditary ranks of cavalry commandant and cloud cavalry captain; his portrait was placed in the Hall of Purple Splendor.

sentences.zh: 三十二年，以記名副都統從征緬甸，師出虎踞關，海蘭察率輕騎先驅，至罕塔，遇賊，殪三人，俘七人，遂攻老官屯，馘二百；

translations.literal: In the thirty-second year, as a by-name Deputy Lieutenant-General he followed the Burma campaign. The army exited Hujiguan; Hai Lancha led light cavalry as vanguard to Hanta, encountered bandits, killed three men, captured seven, then attacked Laoguancun and killed two hundred.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-second year, serving as a deputy lieutenant-general on probation, he joined the Burma campaign. When the army marched out through Hujiguan, Hai Lancha led the light cavalry vanguard to Hanta, where he met the enemy, killed three men, and took seven prisoners. He then assaulted Laoguancun and killed two hundred of the foe.

sentences.zh: 設伏，殲賊四百，賊自猛密出襲我師，援擊卻之。

translations.literal: Setting an ambush, they annihilated four hundred bandits. Bandits sallied from Mengmi to raid our army; reinforcements struck and repulsed them.
translations.idiomatic: After laying an ambush, they wiped out four hundred of the enemy. When bandits sallied from Mengmi to strike the army, supporting troops counterattacked and drove them back.

sentences.zh: 三十三年，再出師，度萬仞關，敗賊戛鳩江，毀江岸賊居，授鑲黃旗蒙古副都統。

translations.literal: In the thirty-third year, the army marched out again, crossed Wanyren Pass, defeated bandits at the Jiujiu River, destroyed bandit dwellings on the riverbank, and he was appointed Deputy Lieutenant-General of the Bordered Yellow Banner Mongols.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-third year the army marched out again, crossed Wanyren Pass, defeated the enemy at the Jiujiu River, and destroyed their riverside settlements. Hai Lancha was then appointed deputy lieutenant-general of the Bordered Yellow Banner Mongols.

sentences.zh: 師薄老官屯，攻賊於錫箔，毀其木柵，賊來攻，急擊之，追戮其強半，縛二人以歸。

translations.literal: The army approached Laoguancun and attacked bandits at Xibo, destroying their wooden palisade. The bandits came to attack; he struck them urgently, pursued and slaughtered more than half, bound two and returned.
translations.idiomatic: As the army neared Laoguancun, he attacked the enemy at Xibo and tore down their wooden palisade. When they counterattacked, he struck back at once, pursued them, and killed more than half before bringing two captives back.

sentences.zh: 既還師，命留軍防邊。

translations.literal: After the army returned, he was ordered to leave troops to defend the border.
translations.idiomatic: When the army withdrew, he was ordered to leave troops behind to guard the frontier.

sentences.zh: 移鑲白旗蒙古副都統。

translations.literal: Transferred to Deputy Lieutenant-General of the Bordered White Banner Mongols.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to deputy lieutenant-general of the Bordered White Banner Mongols.

sentences.zh: 三十六年，師徵金川，命自雲南赴四川與師會。

translations.literal: In the thirty-sixth year, the army campaigned against Jinchuan; he was ordered to go from Yunnan to Sichuan to join the army.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-sixth year, when the army marched against Jinchuan, he was ordered to travel from Yunnan to Sichuan and join the main force.

sentences.zh: 三十七年六月，參贊大臣豐升額方攻美美寨，賊禦戰甚力。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the thirty-seventh year, Participating Minister Feng Sheng'e was attacking the Meimei stockade; the bandits resisted fiercely.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the thirty-seventh year, Participating Minister Feng Sheng'e was assaulting the Meimei stockade, where the enemy put up a fierce defense.

sentences.zh: 海蘭察師至，合力奮擊，克之；

translations.literal: When Hai Lancha's army arrived, they combined strength in fierce attack and took it.
translations.idiomatic: When Hai Lancha's troops arrived, the two forces joined in a furious assault and carried the position.

sentences.zh: 乘勝毀賊寨十三，克木城，師屯其旁山岡，築卡以守。

translations.literal: Riding the victory, they destroyed thirteen bandit stockades, captured the wooden fort, and the army encamped on the hill beside it, building checkpoints to hold.
translations.idiomatic: Pressing the advantage, they destroyed thirteen enemy stockades and seized a wooden fort. The army then encamped on the neighboring hill and built checkpoints to hold the ground.

sentences.zh: 七月，敗賊策卜丹。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, defeated bandits at Cebudan.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month he defeated the enemy at Cebudan.

sentences.zh: 八月，賊出貢噶山左，謀截糧，海蘭察設四伏，斬級百餘。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, bandits emerged from the left of Gongga Mountain planning to intercept grain; Hai Lancha set four ambushes and beheaded over a hundred.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month the enemy came out from the left flank of Gongga Mountain intending to cut the supply lines. Hai Lancha laid four ambushes and killed more than a hundred of them.

sentences.zh: 十月，進攻路頂宗及喀木色爾，破碉卡三百餘，殲賊數百，詔嘉獎，擢正紅旗蒙古都統。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, advanced to attack Ludingzong and Kamusai'er, broke over three hundred blockhouses and checkpoints, annihilated several hundred bandits; imperial commendation; promoted to Lieutenant-General of the Plain Red Banner Mongols.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month he advanced against Ludingzong and Kamusai'er, storming more than three hundred blockhouses and checkpoints and killing several hundred of the enemy. The court issued an edict of praise, and he was promoted to lieutenant-general of the Plain Red Banner Mongols.

sentences.zh: 十一月，進至格實迪，自色木僧格山後取瑪覺烏大寨，仰攻布喇克及扎喀爾寨，得碉卡九十。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, advanced to Geshidi; from behind Semusenge Mountain he took the Madjiewuda large stockade, attacked upward Borak and Zhaka'er stockades, and obtained ninety blockhouses and checkpoints.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month he pushed forward to Geshidi, swung behind Semusenge Mountain to seize the great stockade at Madjiewuda, then attacked uphill against the Borak and Zhaka'er stockades, capturing ninety blockhouses and checkpoints.

sentences.zh: 十二月，進攻明郭宗，突入寨門，焚轉經樓，直搗美諾。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, advanced to attack Mingguozong, burst into the stockade gate, burned the prayer-wheel tower, and drove straight at Meinuo.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month he advanced on Mingguozong, broke through the stockade gate, burned the prayer-wheel tower, and pressed straight toward Meinuo.

sentences.zh: 小金川既定，進討大金川，授參贊大臣，從將軍溫福出西路，自功噶爾拉入。

translations.literal: After Lesser Jinchuan was pacified, he advanced to subdue Greater Jinchuan; appointed Participating Minister; with General Wen Fu on the western route he entered from Gongga'era.
translations.idiomatic: Once Lesser Jinchuan had been pacified, he marched on to subdue Greater Jinchuan. Appointed participating minister, he joined General Wen Fu on the western route and entered through Gongga'era.

sentences.zh: 三十八年二月，趨昔嶺，道經蘇克奈，奪卡二，據木果木後山，與領隊大臣額森特軍合戰，得碉卡五，鑿冰開道，一日而至固木卜爾山。

translations.literal: In the second month of the thirty-eighth year, he rushed toward Xiling; passing Sukenai he seized two checkpoints, occupied the rear hill of Muguomu, joined battle with Leading Minister Esente's army, took five blockhouses and checkpoints, hacked through ice to open a path, and in one day reached Gumubuer Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the thirty-eighth year he hurried toward Xiling. Passing Sukenai, he captured two checkpoints and seized the hill behind Muguomu. Joining Esente's column, he took five blockhouses and checkpoints, cut a road through the ice, and reached Gumubuer Mountain in a single day.

sentences.zh: 山接昔嶺麓，昔嶺多賊碉，當道碉凡十，我師遇賊碉，若山峰縱橫並列，往往為之次第，便指目。

translations.literal: The mountain connects to the foot of Xiling; Xiling has many bandit blockhouses. The blockhouses blocking the path numbered ten in all. When our army encountered bandit blockhouses, if mountain peaks stood side by side across the terrain, they were often numbered in sequence for easy reference.
translations.idiomatic: The ridge joined the lower slopes of Xiling, where enemy blockhouses were thick on the ground. Ten blockhouses altogether barred the route. Whenever peaks stood in parallel ranks along the line of march, the troops numbered the blockhouses in order so they could be identified at a glance.

sentences.zh: 海蘭察與額森特計分兵為六隊，力攻第九、第十二碉，先下，進取第七、第八兩碉，力戰冰雪中。

translations.literal: Hai Lancha and Esente planned to divide the force into six teams, vigorously attacking the ninth and twelfth blockhouses first; once taken, they advanced to seize the seventh and eighth blockhouses, fighting fiercely amid ice and snow.
translations.idiomatic: Hai Lancha and Esente divided their men into six columns and threw their full strength against the ninth and twelfth blockhouses. After those fell, they pushed on to the seventh and eighth, fighting hard through ice and snow.

sentences.zh: 及暮，陽撤兵，賊下追，伏起，殪二百人。

translations.literal: At dusk they feigned withdrawal; the bandits came down in pursuit; the ambush rose and killed two hundred men.
translations.idiomatic: At dusk they feigned a withdrawal. The enemy pursued downhill, whereupon the hidden troops sprang up and killed two hundred men.

sentences.zh: 第五碉尤堅厚，海蘭察運砲轟擊，晝夜無稍休，碉乃破。

translations.literal: The fifth blockhouse was especially strong and thick; Hai Lancha brought up cannon to bombard it day and night without the slightest rest until the blockhouse was broken.
translations.idiomatic: The fifth blockhouse was especially massive and stubborn. Hai Lancha hauled up artillery and battered it day and night without pause until it finally gave way.

sentences.zh: 移軍攻達扎克角山梁，奪獲得斯東寨。

translations.literal: Moving the army to attack Dazhakjiaoshan ridge, they captured and took Desidong stockade.
translations.idiomatic: He then shifted his forces to assault the ridge at Dazhakjiao and captured Desidong stockade.

sentences.zh: 上按地圖示諸將形勢，海蘭察复移軍攻功噶爾拉山口。

translations.literal: The Emperor pointed out the situation to the generals on a map; Hai Lancha again moved the army to attack Gongga'era Pass.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor showed the generals the terrain on a map, after which Hai Lancha again moved his troops to attack Gongga'era Pass.

sentences.zh: 五月，還攻昔嶺，造砲台高與山齊，痛殲守賊。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, returned to attack Xiling, built artillery platforms as high as the mountains, and utterly annihilated the defending bandits.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month he returned to assault Xiling, erecting gun platforms level with the peaks and slaughtering the defenders.

sentences.zh: 六月，後路賊攻陷底木達，進據登春。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, bandits on the rear route attacked and seized Dimuda, then advanced to occupy Dengchun.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month enemy forces on the rear route overran Dimuda and pushed forward to occupy Dengchun.

sentences.zh: 海蘭察還禦，戰正力，俄聞木果木大營有警，疾馳。

translations.literal: Hai Lancha returned to meet them; battle was at its fiercest when suddenly word came of alarm at the Muguomu headquarters, and he galloped at speed.
translations.idiomatic: Hai Lancha turned back to meet them and was locked in fierce combat when sudden word arrived that the Muguomu headquarters was in danger. He raced off at once.

sentences.zh: 次日大營陷，將軍溫福歿於陣。

translations.literal: The next day the headquarters fell; General Wen Fu died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: The next day the headquarters was overrun, and General Wen Fu fell in battle.

sentences.zh: 海蘭察令領隊大臣富興整兵出，而為之殿。

translations.literal: Hai Lancha ordered Leading Minister Fuxing to array the troops and march out, while he himself served as rearguard.
translations.idiomatic: Hai Lancha ordered Leading Minister Fuxing to form the troops and march out while he himself covered the retreat.

sentences.zh: 夜半，至功噶爾拉總兵牛天畀營，度功噶爾拉亦不可守，合軍引退，令額森特等為前導，與富興、普爾普及天畀殿。

translations.literal: At midnight they reached Brigade-General Niu Tianbi's camp at Gongga'era; judging Gongga'era also undefendable, they combined forces and withdrew, putting Esente and others in the van, with Fuxing, Pu'erpu, and Tianbi in the rear.
translations.idiomatic: By midnight they reached Brigade-General Niu Tianbi's camp at Gongga'era. Concluding that the pass could not be held, they united their forces and withdrew, with Esente and others in the van and Fuxing, Pu'erpu, and Tianbi guarding the rear.

sentences.zh: 是日暮，屯崇德。

translations.literal: That evening they encamped at Chongde.
translations.idiomatic: That evening they encamped at Chongde.

sentences.zh: 次日至美諾，與領隊博清額、五岱、和隆武合軍，馳奏請罪。

translations.literal: The next day they reached Meinuo, combined with Leading Ministers Bo Qing'e, Wudai, and Helongwu, and dispatched a memorial requesting punishment.
translations.idiomatic: The following day they reached Meinuo, joined Leading Ministers Bo Qing'e, Wudai, and Helongwu, and sent up a memorial asking to be punished.

sentences.zh: 上諭以「鎮靜，鼓士氣，圖恢復」。

translations.literal: The Emperor instructed: 'Be calm, raise morale, and seek recovery.'
translations.idiomatic: The emperor replied: 'Keep steady, restore the troops' morale, and plan recovery.'

sentences.zh: 與五岱共守美諾，賊屢來攻，均戰退。

translations.literal: Together with Wudai he defended Meinuo; bandits repeatedly attacked and were beaten back in battle each time.
translations.idiomatic: Together with Wudai he held Meinuo, beating back every enemy assault.

sentences.zh: 時當新敗，綠營兵多潰散。

translations.literal: At that time, fresh from defeat, many Green Standard troops had scattered in rout.
translations.idiomatic: The army had just suffered a crushing defeat, and many Green Standard troops had broken and fled.

sentences.zh: 海蘭察請遣回怯卒，毋使搖亂新兵，上從其請。

translations.literal: Hai Lancha requested that cowardly soldiers be sent back, lest they unsettle the new troops; the Emperor granted his request.
translations.idiomatic: Hai Lancha asked that the most cowardly soldiers be sent home so they would not unsettle the fresh recruits, and the emperor approved.

sentences.zh: 尋诇知阿桂方駐軍當噶爾拉，乃分兵千人，令額森特自南山往迎；

translations.literal: Soon reconnaissance learned Agui was encamped at Dangga'era; he divided a thousand troops and ordered Esente to go by the southern mountains to meet him.
translations.idiomatic: Soon his scouts reported that Agui was encamped at Dangga'era. Hai Lancha detached a thousand men and sent Esente south through the mountains to link up with him.

sentences.zh: 又令普爾普將三百人巡鄂克什諸隘口。

translations.literal: He also ordered Pu'erpu to lead three hundred men to patrol the passes at Ekeshi and elsewhere.
translations.idiomatic: He also ordered Pu'erpu to take three hundred men and patrol the passes around Ekeshi.

sentences.zh: 七月，賊大至，美諾、明郭宗俱失守，海蘭察退保日隆。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, bandits came in force; Meinuo and Mingguozong both fell; Hai Lancha retreated to defend Rilong.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month the enemy came in overwhelming strength. Meinuo and Mingguozong both fell, and Hai Lancha withdrew to hold Rilong.

sentences.zh: 上責其不能禦賊，命阿桂按治。

translations.literal: The Emperor reproached him for failing to repel the bandits and ordered Agui to investigate and adjudicate.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor rebuked him for failing to stop the enemy and ordered Agui to investigate and pass judgment.

sentences.zh: 阿桂至日隆，奏：「海蘭察當兵潰時，前後攔截，未與懦卒同潰。

translations.literal: Agui reached Rilong and memorialized: 'When the army collapsed, Hai Lancha blocked and intercepted front and rear and did not flee with the cowardly soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: When Agui reached Rilong, he reported: 'At the moment of collapse Hai Lancha blocked the rout from front and rear and did not flee with the cowards.

sentences.zh: 惟平日不能申明軍律，咎不能辭。」

translations.literal: However, he could not enforce military discipline in ordinary times and cannot escape blame for that.'
translations.idiomatic: Yet in ordinary times he had failed to enforce discipline, and for that he cannot escape blame.'

sentences.zh: 命左授領隊大臣，停俸。

translations.literal: He was ordered to be demoted to Leading Minister on the left and his salary suspended.
translations.idiomatic: He was demoted to leading minister of the left rank and his pay was suspended.

sentences.zh: 十月，命以阿桂為定西將軍，謀再舉，海蘭察偕領隊常清等將八千人自達木巴宗北山取道分三路進，奪別斯滿大小十餘寨。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, Agui was appointed Pacifier of the West to plan another campaign; Hai Lancha together with Leading Minister Changqing and others led eight thousand men from the northern hill of Damubazong by three separate routes, seizing over ten large and small stockades at Biesiman.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Agui was appointed Pacifier of the West and began planning a new offensive. Hai Lancha, with Leading Minister Changqing and others, led eight thousand men from the northern slopes of Damubazong in three columns and captured more than ten large and small stockades at Biesiman.

sentences.zh: 復與富興等攻取帛噶爾角克、底木達、布朗郭宗諸寨，師复克美諾。

translations.literal: Again with Fuxing and others he attacked and took the stockades at Bogerjiaoke, Dimuda, Bulangguozong, and others; the army recovered Meinuo.
translations.idiomatic: He then joined Fuxing and others in storming Bogerjiaoke, Dimuda, Bulangguozong, and other stockades, and the army recaptured Meinuo.

sentences.zh: 上嘉海蘭察奮勉，命支俸。

translations.literal: The Emperor praised Hai Lancha's exertions and ordered his salary restored.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised Hai Lancha's renewed exertions and restored his pay.

sentences.zh: 三十九年正月，阿桂令海蘭察將五千人自明郭宗進谷噶山擊賊，又令與保寧將二千人自喇穆喇穆橫梁繞八十餘裡，攻登古山。

translations.literal: In the first month of the thirty-ninth year, Agui ordered Hai Lancha to lead five thousand men from Mingguozong into Gugashan to strike bandits; he also ordered him with Baoning to lead two thousand men from Lamulamu cross-ridge, circling over eighty li, to attack Denggu Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the thirty-ninth year Agui ordered Hai Lancha to take five thousand men from Mingguozong into Gugashan to strike the enemy, and also to join Baoning with two thousand men in a flanking march of more than eighty li along the Lamulamu ridge against Denggu Mountain.

sentences.zh: 登古山在諸山最峻，羅博瓦山與對峙，亦賊中奇險處。

translations.literal: Denggu Mountain was the steepest among the mountains; Luobowa Mountain faced it in confrontation—it was also an exceptionally perilous bandit stronghold.
translations.idiomatic: Denggu Mountain was the steepest peak in the range. Luobowa Mountain rose opposite it, forming one of the enemy's most formidable strongholds.

sentences.zh: 二月，令普爾普順山梁進，海蘭察出山後，自石罅躍登，搏賊酣戰；

translations.literal: In the second month, Pu'erpu was ordered to advance along the mountain ridge; Hai Lancha emerged from behind the mountain, leaped up through a rock crevice, and grappled with bandits in fierce battle.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month Pu'erpu was sent along the ridge while Hai Lancha came out behind the mountain, scrambled up through a cleft in the rock, and closed with the enemy in brutal hand-to-hand fighting.

sentences.zh: 額森特、保寧至，合力擊賊，賊少卻；

translations.literal: Esente and Baoning arrived; combining forces they struck bandits, who fell back slightly.
translations.idiomatic: When Esente and Baoning arrived, the combined force pressed the attack and the enemy gave ground.

sentences.zh: 復分隊冒死衝突，射之，殪數十人，餘賊負矢遁。

translations.literal: Again they divided teams to charge desperately; shooting them, they killed several dozen; the remaining bandits fled burdened with arrows.
translations.idiomatic: They split into columns and charged again at the risk of their lives, shooting down several dozen men before the survivors fled, many already wounded by arrows.

sentences.zh: 乃還取羅博瓦前山，攻第三、第四峰，而額森特攻第二峰，普爾普攻第一峰，俱克之。

translations.literal: Then they turned back to take Luobowa's forward mountain, attacking the third and fourth peaks, while Esente attacked the second peak and Pu'erpu the first—all were taken.
translations.idiomatic: They then swung back to seize the forward slopes of Luobowa: Hai Lancha took the third and fourth peaks, Esente the second, and Pu'erpu the first. All fell.

sentences.zh: 上諗羅博瓦為賊險要門戶，海蘭察力攻功最，授內大臣。

translations.literal: The Emperor acknowledged Luobowa as the bandits' strategic gateway; Hai Lancha's vigorous attack achieved the greatest merit; he was appointed Inner Court Minister.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor recognized Luobowa as the enemy's strategic gateway and judged Hai Lancha's assault the decisive feat. He was appointed inner court minister.

sentences.zh: 三月，從第四峰下，進攻得斯東寨，克之。

translations.literal: In the third month, descending from the fourth peak, they advanced to attack Desidong stockade and took it.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month he descended from the fourth peak, advanced on Desidong stockade, and captured it.

sentences.zh: 四月，賊乘霧雨於山坡立兩碉，海蘭察率兵毀之。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, bandits took advantage of fog and rain to erect two blockhouses on the hillside; Hai Lancha led troops to destroy them.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month the enemy used fog and rain as cover to throw up two blockhouses on the slope. Hai Lancha led his men up and destroyed them.

sentences.zh: 五月，於喇穆喇穆山後築柵，賊屢自林中來犯，與額森特合擊，賊披靡走。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, building a palisade behind Lamulamu Mountain, bandits repeatedly came from the forest to attack; together with Esente he combined strikes and the bandits scattered in rout.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, after building a palisade behind Lamulamu Mountain, he beat off repeated enemy raids from the woods. Joining Esente in a counterattack, he routed the foe completely.

sentences.zh: 六月，攻色淜普岡，賊設大碉六，互相應。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, attacked Seqinpugang; bandits set six large blockhouses in mutual support.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month he assaulted Seqinpugang, where the enemy had built six large blockhouses covering one another.

sentences.zh: 額森特克左兩碉，烏什哈達克右一碉，海蘭察獨克中三碉及附近卡寨。

translations.literal: Esente took the two left blockhouses; Ushihada took one on the right; Hai Lancha alone took the three center blockhouses and nearby checkpoints and stockades.
translations.idiomatic: Esente captured the two blockhouses on the left, Ushihada the one on the right, and Hai Lancha single-handedly stormed the three central blockhouses along with the neighboring checkpoints and stockades.

sentences.zh: 七月，抵色淜普，南崖石壁陡滑，督兵手足攀援上，殲東西峰守碉賊殆盡。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, reaching Seqinpu, the southern cliff had sheer slippery stone walls; he urged troops to climb hand and foot; bandits defending blockhouses on the eastern and western peaks were nearly all annihilated.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, reaching Seqinpu, he faced a southern cliff of sheer, slick rock and drove his men up hand over hand. The defenders on the eastern and western peaks were nearly wiped out.

sentences.zh: 又自喇穆喇穆山麓乘勝攻日則丫口，取碉卡百餘，賊堅守該布達什諾木城。

translations.literal: Again from the foot of Lamulamu Mountain, riding victory, attacked Rizaiyakou, taking over a hundred blockhouses and checkpoints; bandits held firm at Gaibudashinuomu fort.
translations.idiomatic: Pressing on from the foot of Lamulamu Mountain, he attacked Rizaiyakou and took more than a hundred blockhouses and checkpoints. The enemy still held firm at Gaibudashinuomu fort.

sentences.zh: 師循山溝，海蘭察出其左，額森特出其右，官達色出中路，三道並進，遂逼遜克爾宗。

translations.literal: The army followed the mountain ravine—Hai Lancha on the left, Esente on the right, Guandase on the center path—all three columns advanced together and thus pressed Xunke'erzong.
translations.idiomatic: The army advanced up the ravine in three columns—Hai Lancha on the left, Esente on the right, and Guandase in the center—and closed in on Xunke'erzong.

sentences.zh: 上嘉海蘭察為諸將倡，屢克險要，賜號綽爾和羅科巴圖魯，並賚白金三百。

translations.literal: The Emperor praised Hai Lancha as leader among the generals, repeatedly taking perilous strongpoints; granted the title Chuo'erheluoke Baturu and bestowed three hundred taels of white silver.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised Hai Lancha as the foremost of the generals for repeatedly carrying the most dangerous positions. He was granted the baturu title Chuo'erheluoke Baturu and awarded three hundred taels of silver.

sentences.zh: 八月，偕額森特自遜克爾宗峰脊分左右翼仰攻，登碉頂，縱火毀碉卡二百餘；

translations.literal: In the eighth month, together with Esente from Xunke'erzong peak ridge, divided left and right wings attacking upward, climbed to blockhouse tops, set fire destroying over two hundred blockhouses and checkpoints.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month he and Esente climbed the ridge of Xunke'erzong, split into left and right wings, fought their way to the tops of the blockhouses, and burned more than two hundred blockhouses and checkpoints.

sentences.zh: 又旁出遜克爾宗西，逼賊寨，督兵躍進。

translations.literal: Again diverging west of Xunke'erzong, pressed on bandit stockades, urging troops to leap forward.
translations.idiomatic: Swinging west from Xunke'erzong, he pressed the enemy stockades and drove his men forward in a headlong rush.

sentences.zh: 賊穴地匿，不敢出。

translations.literal: The bandits hid in burrows in the ground and did not dare emerge.
translations.idiomatic: The enemy burrowed into underground shelters and dared not come out.

sentences.zh: 九月，取遜克爾宗水碉，斷賊汲道。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, took Xunke'erzong's water blockhouse, cutting the bandits' water route.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month he seized the water blockhouse at Xunke'erzong and cut off the enemy's supply of water.

sentences.zh: 乘勝攻官寨，賊槍石如雨，督兵奮進，額森特取其右第一寨；

translations.literal: Riding victory, attacked the official stockade; bandits' muskets and stones fell like rain; he urged troops forward fiercely. Esente took their right first stockade.
translations.idiomatic: Pressing the advantage, he assaulted the chief stockade as musket fire and stones rained down. He drove his men forward without slackening. Esente captured the first stockade on the right.

sentences.zh: 海蘭察左頰傷，裹創力戰，克第二寨。

translations.literal: Hai Lancha was wounded on the left cheek; he bound his wound and fought on vigorously, taking the second stockade.
translations.idiomatic: Hai Lancha was struck in the left cheek. Binding the wound, he fought on and took the second stockade.

sentences.zh: 軍中目賊渠所居大寨為「官寨」，亦曰「正寨」，示與他碉卡別也。

translations.literal: The army called the great stockade where the bandit chieftain lived the 'Official Stockade,' also called the 'Chief Stockade,' to distinguish it from other blockhouses and checkpoints.
translations.idiomatic: The troops called the chieftain's great stockade the 'Official Stockade,' or simply the 'Chief Stockade,' to distinguish it from the lesser blockhouses and checkpoints.

sentences.zh: 上以海蘭察傷甫平，即督兵攻奪堅碉，手敕嘉獎。

translations.literal: The Emperor, because Hai Lancha's wound had only just healed and he immediately directed troops to storm a stubborn blockhouse, sent a personally written edict of praise.
translations.idiomatic: Because Hai Lancha's wound had barely healed before he was back leading assaults on the hardest positions, the emperor sent him a personally drafted edict of praise.

sentences.zh: 十月，克默格爾山樑及密拉噶拉木，得大寨一、石碉四，山后凱立葉官寨亦下，复授參贊大臣。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, took Mogeer mountain ridge and Milagala wood, obtaining one large stockade and four stone blockhouses; the Kailiye official stockade behind the mountain also fell; again appointed Participating Minister.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month he took the Mogeer ridge and Milagala woods, capturing one great stockade and four stone blockhouses. The Kailiye chief stockade behind the mountain fell as well, and he was again appointed participating minister.

sentences.zh: 又自默格爾西進攻布拉克森及格思巴爾，焚寨落數百，於是凱立葉附近碉卡皆盡。

translations.literal: Again from west of Mogeer advanced to attack Bolakesen and Gesiba'er, burning hundreds of stockade settlements; thus nearby blockhouses and checkpoints around Kailiye were all cleared.
translations.idiomatic: From west of Mogeer he pushed on against Bolakesen and Gesiba'er, burning hundreds of stockade settlements until every blockhouse and checkpoint around Kailiye had been cleared.

sentences.zh: 命在御前侍衛上行走。

translations.literal: Appointed to serve as Imperial Bodyguard above the rank of attendant.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed to serve in the imperial guard with rank above attendant.

sentences.zh: 十一月，夜度山溝，進格魯克古丫山，崖磡壁立，督兵揉登，天明，登者六百人，賊並力拒，奪二碉，循山樑下攻桑噶斯瑪特；

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, crossing a mountain ravine by night, advanced to Gelukeguya Mountain; cliffs stood sheer; he urged troops to scramble up; at daybreak six hundred had ascended; bandits resisted with combined strength, seizing two blockhouses, then followed the ridge down to attack Sangasimate.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month he crossed a ravine by night and advanced on Gelukeguya Mountain, where the cliffs rose sheer. He drove his men up the rock face; by dawn six hundred had gained the heights. The enemy resisted with all their strength, but he took two blockhouses and then descended the ridge to attack Sangasimate.

sentences.zh: 別遣兵自陡烏當噶山進克沙木拉渠什爾德諸寨，复督兵攻克革什戎岡及作固頂。

translations.literal: Separately dispatching troops from Diewudangga Mountain advanced to take Shamolaqushierde and other stockades; again directed troops to take Geshironggang and Zuoguding.
translations.idiomatic: He detached a column from Diewudangga Mountain to capture Shamolaqushierde and other stockades, then personally directed the assault on Geshironggang and Zuoguding.

sentences.zh: 賊寨橫越諸山，下溝上樑，鼓勇徑度，盡克諸碉寨，與丹壩軍合。

translations.literal: Bandit stockades stretched across the mountains, descending ravines and ascending ridges, advancing boldly straight through; all blockhouses and stockades were taken, joining the Danba army.
translations.idiomatic: Enemy stockades sprawled across the mountains above ravines and along ridges. Hai Lancha drove straight through without hesitation, capturing every blockhouse and stockade until he linked up with the Danba army.

sentences.zh: 十二月，抵桑噶斯瑪特山，賊於碉外設木城為護。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, reaching Sangasimate Mountain, bandits set up a wooden fort outside the blockhouse as protection.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, reaching Sangasimate Mountain, he found the enemy had built a wooden fort outside the blockhouse as an outer defense.

sentences.zh: 師自柵隙發矢，或拔柵木撞之，城立毀。

translations.literal: The army sent arrows through gaps in the palisade, or pulled palisade posts to batter it; the fort was immediately destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: The troops shot arrows through gaps in the palisade or tore out its posts to batter the fort down. It collapsed at once.

sentences.zh: 四十年正月，自康薩爾分路進剿，據山溝碉寨。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fortieth year, from Kangsa'er divided routes to advance in suppression, occupying blockhouses and stockades in mountain ravines.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the fortieth year he advanced from Kangsa'er in divided columns, clearing blockhouses and stockades from the mountain ravines.

sentences.zh: 二月，克甲爾納沿河諸寨。

translations.literal: In the second month, took Jia'erna and other stockades along the river.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month he captured Jia'erna and the other riverside stockades.

sentences.zh: 進攻勒吉爾博寨，海蘭察克山麓碉二。

translations.literal: Advanced to attack Lejierbo stockade; Hai Lancha took two foothill blockhouses.
translations.idiomatic: Advancing against Lejierbo stockade, Hai Lancha seized two blockhouses at the foot of the slope.

sentences.zh: 賊自噶爾丹寺來援，擊敗之。

translations.literal: Bandits came from Ga'erdan Temple to relieve; they were defeated in battle.
translations.idiomatic: Enemy reinforcements marched out from Ga'erdan Temple, but he defeated them in battle.

sentences.zh: 四月，將軍阿桂令往宜喜，會明亮诇兵入道，約期合攻。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, General Agui ordered him to go to Yixi to meet Mingliang's reconnaissance forces entering the route, with a fixed date for combined attack.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month General Agui ordered him to Yixi to rendezvous with Mingliang's scouting force as it opened the route, with a fixed date set for a combined assault.

sentences.zh: 上賜緞二端。

translations.literal: The Emperor bestowed two rolls of satin.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor rewarded him with two bolts of satin.

sentences.zh: 尋分兵千人偕福康安赴宜喜，先取甲索賊碉，進攻得楞山岡，皆下，焚薩克薩谷大小寨落數百，西北兩路兵合。

translations.literal: Soon dividing a thousand troops to accompany Fukang'an to Yixi, first took Jiasuo bandit blockhouse, advanced to attack Deleng mountain ridge—all fell; burned hundreds of large and small stockade settlements at Saksagu Valley; northwest and west route armies united.
translations.idiomatic: He soon detached a thousand men to accompany Fukang'an to Yixi, first storming the Jiasuo blockhouse and then the Deleng ridge. All fell. He burned hundreds of stockade settlements in Saksagu Valley, and the northwestern and western columns joined forces.

sentences.zh: 五月，攻上、下巴木通大碉，並克色爾外、安吉、達佳布諸寨，焚噶爾丹寺。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, attacked upper and lower Bamutong large blockhouses, and jointly took Sei'erwai, Anji, Dajiabu and other stockades; burned Ga'erdan Temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month he assaulted the great blockhouses at upper and lower Bamutong and together captured Sei'erwai, Anji, Dajiabu, and other stockades, then burned Ga'erdan Temple.

sentences.zh: 六月，自榮噶爾博山梁攻巴佔寨落，賊恃險拒攻，未下；

translations.literal: In the sixth month, from Rongga'erbo mountain ridge attacked Bazhan stockade settlements; bandits relied on peril to resist attack—not taken.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month he attacked the Bazhan stockade settlements from the Rongga'erbo ridge, but the enemy held the heights and the positions could not be taken.

sentences.zh: 紆道繞舍圖枉卡以入。

translations.literal: He took a circuitous route around Shedituwang checkpoint to enter.
translations.idiomatic: He therefore swung around Shedituwang checkpoint by a roundabout route.

sentences.zh: 海蘭察督兵進據昆色爾山梁，克果克多碉，進至拉枯喇嘛寺。

translations.literal: Hai Lancha directed troops advancing to occupy Kunse'er mountain ridge, took Guokeduo blockhouse, advanced to Lakulama Temple.
translations.idiomatic: Hai Lancha led his men onto the Kunse'er ridge, captured Guokeduo blockhouse, and pushed forward to Lakulama Temple.

sentences.zh: 再進經菑則大海，又攻章噶上下十餘寨，盡克之。

translations.literal: Advancing again through Zaicze Great Sea, again attacked over ten stockades above and below Zhangga—all taken.
translations.idiomatic: Moving on through Zaicze Great Sea, he attacked more than ten stockades above and below Zhangga and took them all.

sentences.zh: 合諸路兵逼勒烏圍，海蘭察自托古魯逾溝直上山梁。

translations.literal: Combined forces from all routes pressed Lewuwei; Hai Lancha from Tuogulu crossed the ravine straight up the ridge.
translations.idiomatic: As the combined columns closed on Lewuwei, Hai Lancha crossed the ravine from Tuogulu and climbed straight up the ridge.

sentences.zh: 八月，取隆斯得寨三，分地設伏，遂克勒烏圍。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, took three Longside stockades, divided territory setting ambushes, and thus took Lewuwei.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month he captured three Longside stockades, deployed ambushes across the ground, and thereby took Lewuwei.

sentences.zh: 九月，整軍進攻噶拉依。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, arrayed troops to attack Gelayi.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month he reformed his army and advanced against Gelayi.

sentences.zh: 初自達思裡正路入，慮賊防密，改自達烏達圍進。

translations.literal: Initially entering by Dasli main road, fearing bandit defenses were tight, changed to advance from Dawudawei.
translations.idiomatic: At first he intended to enter by the main road through Dasli, but fearing the enemy defenses there were too strong, he changed course and advanced from Dawudawei instead.

sentences.zh: 海蘭察繞至莫魯古上，連奪噶克底、綽爾丹諸寨，又克西里山梁並科布曲諸碉。

translations.literal: Hai Lancha circled to above Molugu, in succession seized Gakedi, Chuo'erdan and other stockades, and again took Xili mountain ridge together with Kebuqu blockhouses.
translations.idiomatic: Hai Lancha swung around to the heights above Molugu, capturing in succession Gakedi, Chuo'erdan, and other stockades, then seized the Xili ridge together with the blockhouses at Kebuqu.

sentences.zh: 十月，攻達噶，自中路入，分兵張兩翼出旁徑，克​​兩堅碉，下攻雅瑪朋寨。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, attacked Daga, entering by the center route, dividing troops to spread two wings along side paths, took two strong blockhouses, and descended to attack Yamapeng stockade.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month he assaulted Daga, advancing by the central route while detachments spread along flanking paths to capture two stubborn blockhouses, then pressed downhill against Yamapeng stockade.

sentences.zh: 閏十月，據黃草坪，築柵斷賊援。

translations.literal: In the intercalary tenth month, occupied Huangcaoping, built palisades to cut off bandit reinforcements.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary tenth month he seized Huangcaoping and threw up palisades to block enemy reinforcements.

sentences.zh: 賊起木城，海蘭察督兵陟山，自上壓下，克之。

translations.literal: The bandits raised a wooden fort; Hai Lancha directed troops up the mountain, pressing down from above, and took it.
translations.idiomatic: When the enemy threw up a wooden fort, Hai Lancha led his men up the slope and crushed it from above.

sentences.zh: 十一月，分道攻奔布魯木，夜迫山下，焚賊木城，遂據西里正寨。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, divided routes to attack Benbulu, by night pressing to the foot of the mountain, burned the bandits' wooden fort, and then occupied the Xili chief stockade.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month he attacked Benbulu by divided columns, pressing to the mountain foot by night, burning the enemy wooden fort, and then seizing the Xili chief stockade.

sentences.zh: 又克舍勒固租魯寨四。

translations.literal: Again took four stockades at Sheleguzu.
translations.idiomatic: He also captured four stockades at Sheleguzu.

sentences.zh: 進攻雅瑪朋正寨，從中路設伏，偕普爾普等盡克附近寨落。

translations.literal: Advanced to attack Yamapeng chief stockade, set an ambush on the center route, and together with Pu'erpu and others completely took nearby stockade settlements.
translations.idiomatic: Advancing on the Yamapeng chief stockade, he laid an ambush along the central route and, with Pu'erpu and others, cleared every neighboring settlement.

sentences.zh: 十二月，克勒隈勒木通石碉，築柵至科布曲。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, took the stone blockhouse at Leweilemutong, building palisades as far as Kebuqu.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month he captured the stone blockhouse at Leweilemutong and extended palisades all the way to Kebuqu.

sentences.zh: 海蘭察冒槍石進，乘勝克索隆古、得木巴爾、們都斯諸寨。

translations.literal: Hai Lancha braved musket fire and stones to advance, and riding victory took the stockades at Suolonggu, Demuba'er, and Mendusi.
translations.idiomatic: Braving musket fire and falling stones, Hai Lancha pressed forward and, in the wake of victory, seized Suolonggu, Demuba'er, Mendusi, and other stockades.

sentences.zh: 賊又於布哈爾下積木設伏拒師，海蘭察分兵三道並進，立時攻破，遂取奇石磯；

translations.literal: The bandits again piled wood below Buhar to set an ambush resisting the army; Hai Lancha divided troops into three columns advancing together, broke through at once, and then took Qishiji.
translations.idiomatic: The enemy again heaped timber below Buhar to ambush the army, but Hai Lancha attacked in three simultaneous columns, broke the position at once, and took Qishiji.

sentences.zh: 又遣兵悉收庫爾納、額木里多諸寨，及巴斯科官寨。

translations.literal: He also sent troops to recover all the stockades at Ku'erna, Emuli, and elsewhere, as well as the Bashike official stockade.
translations.idiomatic: He also sent troops to recover the stockades at Ku'erna, Emuli, and elsewhere, together with the Bashike chief stockade.

sentences.zh: 四十一年正月，克舍齊、雍中兩寺。

translations.literal: In the first month of the forty-first year, took the two monasteries at Sheqi and Yongzhong.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the forty-first year he captured the monasteries at Sheqi and Yongzhong.

sentences.zh: 海蘭察屯兵噶拉依河岸，扼要隘。

translations.literal: Hai Lancha encamped troops on the Gelayi riverbank, holding the strategic passes.
translations.idiomatic: Hai Lancha stationed his troops on the Gelayi riverbank, commanding the critical passes.

sentences.zh: 尋偕福康安、普爾普等截噶拉依右路，克大石卡，移砲進擊扎木什克寨。

translations.literal: Soon together with Fukang'an, Pu'erpu, and others he intercepted the right route to Gelayi, took the great stone checkpoint, and moved artillery forward to bombard the Zhamushike stockade.
translations.idiomatic: Soon, joining Fukang'an and Pu'erpu, he cut the right route to Gelayi, seized a major stone checkpoint, and brought up artillery to batter the Zhamushike stockade.

sentences.zh: 二月，大金川酋索諾木就縛，金川平，封海蘭察一等超勇侯，賜雙眼花翎。

translations.literal: In the second month, the Greater Jinchuan chieftain Suonuomu was bound and submitted; Jinchuan was pacified. Hai Lancha was enfeoffed as Marquis of Chaoyong of the first rank and granted the double-eyed peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month the Greater Jinchuan chieftain Suonuomu was captured and bound. With Jinchuan pacified, Hai Lancha was enfeoffed as first-rank Marquis of Chaoyong and granted the double-eyed peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 師還，郊勞，賜御用鞍轡馬一。

translations.literal: When the army returned, he was welcomed outside the capital and bestowed one imperial saddle and horse.
translations.idiomatic: On the army's return he was welcomed outside the capital and given an imperial saddle and horse.

sentences.zh: 飲至，賜緞二十端、白金千。

translations.literal: At the imperial banquet he was granted twenty bolts of satin and a thousand taels of silver.
translations.idiomatic: At the imperial banquet he received twenty bolts of satin and a thousand taels of silver.

sentences.zh: 圖形紫光閣，列前五十功臣。

translations.literal: His portrait was placed in the Hall of Purple Splendor among the first fifty meritorious ministers.
translations.idiomatic: His portrait was placed in the Hall of Purple Splendor among the fifty foremost meritorious ministers.

sentences.zh: 授領侍衛內大臣。

translations.literal: Appointed leading imperial bodyguard and inner court minister.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed leading imperial bodyguard and inner court minister.

sentences.zh: 補公中佐領。

translations.literal: Supplemented as company commander of the imperial guard.
translations.idiomatic: He was also given the post of company commander in the imperial guard.

sentences.zh: 四十六年三月，甘肅撒拉爾回蘇四十三爭立新教為亂，破河州，據華林山。

translations.literal: In the third month of the forty-sixth year, the Salar Muslim Suo Sishi of Gansu stirred up disorder over the establishment of a new sect, broke Hezhou, and occupied Hualin Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the forty-sixth year the Salar Muslim Suo Sishi of Gansu rose in revolt over the founding of a new sect, overran Hezhou, and seized Hualin Mountain.

sentences.zh: 命大學士阿桂視師，疏請以海蘭察自佐。

translations.literal: The Grand Secretary Agui was ordered to take command of the army and memorialized requesting Hai Lancha as his assistant.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Secretary Agui was ordered to take the field and asked that Hai Lancha serve under him.

sentences.zh: 上已命為領隊，馳驛詣軍前。

translations.literal: The Emperor had already appointed him leading commander and ordered him to ride post-horses to the front.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor had already named him leading commander and ordered him to the front by relay post.

sentences.zh: 四月，抵蘭州，督兵攻龍尾山，賊伏穴中守。

translations.literal: In the fourth month he reached Lanzhou and directed troops to attack Longwei Mountain; the bandits defended from burrows in the ground.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month he reached Lanzhou and led the assault on Longwei Mountain, where the rebels held out in underground burrows.

sentences.zh: 阿桂至，令海蘭察盡護諸軍。

translations.literal: When Agui arrived, he ordered Hai Lancha to take overall charge of all the armies.
translations.idiomatic: When Agui arrived, he placed Hai Lancha in overall command of the forces.

sentences.zh: 五月，偕明亮、額森特等分左右翼陟山殺賊。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, together with Mingliang, Esente, and others, he ascended the mountain by left and right wings and killed bandits.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, with Mingliang, Esente, and others, he climbed the mountain in two wings and slaughtered the rebels.

sentences.zh: 复逾水磨溝，猝上華林山，賊駭，傾穴出；

translations.literal: Again crossing Shuimogou, he suddenly ascended Hualin Mountain; the bandits were terrified and poured out of their burrows.
translations.idiomatic: Crossing Shuimogou, he suddenly stormed Hualin Mountain. The rebels were terrified and swarmed out of their burrows.

sentences.zh: 師陽退，賊來逐，還兵擊之，殲賊甚眾。

translations.literal: The army feigned retreat; the bandits came in pursuit; turning back they struck them and annihilated a great many.
translations.idiomatic: The army feigned a retreat; when the rebels pursued, the troops wheeled about and killed a great many of them.

sentences.zh: 賊被創鉅，望見海蘭察乘馬出陣，輒先驚竄。

translations.literal: The bandits had suffered heavy wounds; whenever they saw Hai Lancha ride out into battle, they fled in alarm beforehand.
translations.idiomatic: Badly mauled, the rebels would scatter in panic at the mere sight of Hai Lancha riding into battle.

sentences.zh: 閏五月，將阿拉山馬兵繞出華林山江南潛伏，候賊至，突出壕殺賊；

translations.literal: In the intercalary fifth month, he led Alashan cavalry in a circuit south of the Yangzi side of Hualin Mountain to lie in ambush; when the bandits arrived, they burst from the trench and killed them.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary fifth month he led Alashan cavalry around to the south bank of Hualin Mountain to lie in wait; when the rebels came up, they sprang from the trenches and cut them down.

sentences.zh: 又督屯練兵取賊卡四，步戰中槍傷。

translations.literal: He also directed native militia to take four bandit checkpoints and was wounded by musket fire in the infantry fighting.
translations.idiomatic: He also directed native militia in taking four rebel checkpoints and was wounded by musket fire in the close fighting.

sentences.zh: 上憫其勞，諭阿桂撫慰。

translations.literal: The Emperor pitied his labors and instructed Agui to comfort him.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor, pitying his exertions, told Agui to see to his comfort.

sentences.zh: 賊據大卡負嵎，海蘭察單騎至五泉山審度，還向華林山暫伏壕中，诇賊還，急起猛攻，遂克之。

translations.literal: The bandits held the great checkpoint in a defiant position; Hai Lancha rode alone to Wuchuan Mountain to reconnoiter, then returned to lie briefly in ambush in trenches on Hualin Mountain; when scouts reported the bandits returning, he rose in a fierce attack and took it.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels clung to a great checkpoint in a stubborn defile. Hai Lancha rode alone to Wuchuan Mountain to reconnoiter, then hid in the trenches on Hualin Mountain until the enemy returned, when he sprang up in a furious assault and carried the position.

sentences.zh: 入賊營，焚所居板屋。

translations.literal: Entering the bandit camp, they burned the plank houses where they lived.
translations.idiomatic: Entering the rebel camp, they burned the plank houses in which the enemy had lived.

sentences.zh: 賊退保華林寺，督兵逼寺立柵，殲賊眾，馘渠傳示各回民。

translations.literal: The bandits withdrew to defend Hualin Temple; he directed troops to press the temple and build palisades, annihilated the bandit force, beheaded the ringleaders, and displayed them to the various Muslim communities.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels fell back on Hualin Temple. He pressed the temple, threw up palisades, wiped out the rebel force, beheaded the ringleaders, and displayed their heads to the Muslim communities.

sentences.zh: 賊平，上諭獎海蘭察功，官其子安祿三等侍衛。

translations.literal: When the bandits were pacified, the Emperor issued instructions praising Hai Lancha's merit and appointed his son Anlu third-class imperial bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: After the rebellion was crushed, the emperor praised Hai Lancha's service and appointed his son Anlu third-class imperial bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 四十九年四月，甘肅回复私起新教，聚眾滋事。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the forty-ninth year, Muslims in Gansu again privately established a new sect and gathered crowds to make trouble.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the forty-ninth year Muslims in Gansu again founded a new sect in secret and gathered mobs to make trouble.

sentences.zh: 命尚書福康安視師，授海蘭察參贊大臣。

translations.literal: Minister Fukang'an was ordered to take command of the army; Hai Lancha was appointed participating minister.
translations.idiomatic: Minister Fukang'an was ordered to take the field, and Hai Lancha was made participating minister.

sentences.zh: 賊屯靜寧底店，海蘭察督巴圖魯侍衛等進逼賊巢，設伏痛殲之，遂破石峰堡，擒賊渠張文慶等。

translations.literal: The bandits were encamped at Didian, Jingning; Hai Lancha directed baturu guards and others to press on the bandit nest, set an ambush, and annihilated them severely; then broke Shifengbao and captured the ringleader Zhang Wenqing and others.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels were encamped at Didian in Jingning. Hai Lancha led the baturu guards forward against their nest, laid an ambush, and slaughtered them in great numbers, then stormed Shifengbao and captured the ringleader Zhang Wenqing and others.

sentences.zh: 擢安祿二等侍衛，予騎都尉世職。

translations.literal: Anlu was promoted to second-class imperial bodyguard and granted the hereditary office of cavalry commandant.
translations.idiomatic: Anlu was promoted to second-class imperial bodyguard and granted the hereditary rank of cavalry commandant.

sentences.zh: 五十二年，台灣林爽文為亂，命將軍福康安視師，仍授海蘭察參贊大臣。

translations.literal: In the fifty-second year, Lin Shuangwen rebelled in Taiwan; General Fukang'an was ordered to take command of the army, and Hai Lancha was again appointed participating minister.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-second year Lin Shuangwen rose in rebellion in Taiwan. General Fukang'an was ordered to take command, and Hai Lancha was again made participating minister.

sentences.zh: 十月，渡鹿仔港，登岸後三日，率巴圖魯二十人至彰化八卦山察地勢。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, crossing Luzai Harbor, three days after landing he led twenty baturu guards to Baguashan at Zhanghua to survey the terrain.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, after crossing Luzai Harbor and landing, he took twenty baturu guards within three days to Baguashan at Zhanghua to survey the ground.

sentences.zh: 賊方於山上築卡，海蘭察躍馬登，賊擁至，發箭殪數賊，餘驚遁。

translations.literal: The bandits were just building a checkpoint on the mountain; Hai Lancha leaped his horse up; the bandits crowded in; he shot arrows and killed several bandits; the rest fled in alarm.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels were building a checkpoint on the hill. Hai Lancha spurred his horse up the slope; when they swarmed around him, he shot several dead and the rest fled in panic.

sentences.zh: 上以其能用少擊眾，諭獎之。

translations.literal: The Emperor, because he could use few to strike many, issued instructions commending him.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor commended him for defeating superior numbers with a handful of men.

sentences.zh: 十一月，自笨港開道​​，同福康安援嘉義，分隊五，沿途搜剿，自崙仔頂、崙仔尾逼至牛稠山，賊萬餘阻溪守。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, opening a road from Bengang, together with Fukang'an he relieved Jiayi, dividing into five teams and searching and suppressing along the route from Lunzaiding and Lunzaiwei to Niuchoushan, where more than ten thousand bandits blocked the stream in defense.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month he opened a road from Bengang and, with Fukang'an, relieved Jiayi. Dividing into five columns, they swept forward from Lunzaiding and Lunzaiwei to Niuchoushan, where more than ten thousand rebels barred the stream.

sentences.zh: 海蘭察越溪徑上山梁，攻克賊柵，賊遁，追至大排竹，盡焚賊藔，嘉義圍解。

translations.literal: Hai Lancha crossed the stream by a direct path up the ridge, stormed and took the bandit palisade; the bandits fled; pursuing to Dapaizhu, they burned all the bandit huts; the siege of Jiayi was lifted.
translations.idiomatic: Hai Lancha forded the stream and climbed straight up the ridge, stormed the rebel palisade, and drove them off. Pursuing to Dapaizhu, he burned every rebel hut and lifted the siege of Jiayi.

sentences.zh: 上嘉海蘭察身先士卒，勇略過人，進二等超勇公，賜紅寶石頂、四團龍補褂。

translations.literal: The Emperor praised Hai Lancha for fighting at the head of his troops with courage and strategy surpassing others; he was advanced to Duke of Chaoyong of the second rank and granted a ruby finial and a four-round-dragon surcoat.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised Hai Lancha for leading from the front with courage and stratagem beyond his peers, advanced him to second-rank Duke of Chaoyong, and granted him a ruby finial and a four-dragon surcoat.

sentences.zh: 十二月，剿城西大崙莊及海岸賊，又焚城東興化店、員林賊莊，督兵直剿北路。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, he suppressed bandits at Dalun Village west of the city and along the coast, also burned rebel villages at Xinghuadian and Yuanlin east of the city, and directed troops in a straight drive to suppress the northern route.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month he crushed rebels at Dalun Village west of the city and along the coast, burned the rebel settlements at Xinghuadian and Yuanlin to the east, and drove straight up the northern route.

sentences.zh: 時賊屯中林，尤剽悍，海蘭察冒槍石馳剿，克之。

translations.literal: At that time the bandits were encamped at Zhonglin, especially fierce; Hai Lancha braved musket fire and stones in a rapid pursuit and took it.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels then held Zhonglin, where they were especially fierce. Hai Lancha charged through musket fire and falling stones and took the place.

sentences.zh: 大埔林、大埔尾諸莊賊俱潰。

translations.literal: The bandits at the villages of Dapulin and Dapuwei all collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels at Dapulin, Dapuwei, and neighboring villages all broke and fled.

sentences.zh: 收鬥六門，抵水沙連，賊已遁。

translations.literal: He recovered Douliumen and reached Shuishalian; the bandits had already fled.
translations.idiomatic: He recovered Douliumen and reached Shuishalian, but the enemy had already fled.

sentences.zh: 尋踪搜捕，見賊渠方乘馬執幟，射墜馬，獲以歸。

translations.literal: Following their tracks in search, he saw a bandit chieftain riding a horse and holding a banner; he shot him from his horse and brought him back alive.
translations.idiomatic: Tracking them down, he saw a rebel chieftain on horseback carrying a banner, shot him from the saddle, and brought him back alive.

sentences.zh: 進攻大里杙，林爽文起事地也，殲賊目數十、賊黨二百。

translations.literal: Advancing to attack Daliyi, where Lin Shuangwen had raised the rebellion, he killed several dozen bandit leaders and two hundred followers.
translations.idiomatic: Advancing on Daliyi, where Lin Shuangwen had begun the uprising, he killed several dozen rebel leaders and two hundred followers.

sentences.zh: 林爽文逃入番社，即自內山平砦仔逐賊至集集埔。

translations.literal: Lin Shuangwen fled into the aboriginal territory; he at once pursued from Pingzai in the inner mountains to Jijipu.
translations.idiomatic: Lin Shuangwen fled into aboriginal territory; Hai Lancha at once pursued from Pingzai in the inner mountains to Jijipu.

sentences.zh: 賊砦前阻大溪，海蘭察策馬迳渡，盡殲砦中賊，追十餘裡，至浩淮角，焚草藔千。

translations.literal: A great stream blocked the front of the bandit fort; Hai Lancha spurred his horse straight across, annihilated all the bandits in the fort, pursued more than ten li to Haohuaijiao, and burned a thousand grass huts.
translations.idiomatic: A great stream barred the rebel fort. Hai Lancha rode straight across, wiped out every defender in the fort, pursued more than ten li to Haohuaijiao, and burned a thousand grass huts.

sentences.zh: 進剿小半天山寨，海蘭察遍歷東勢角山峰獅子頭、打鐵藔、叚骨、合歡諸社，至極北炭窯，捕治餘賊。

translations.literal: Advancing to suppress the Xiaobantian Mountain stockade, Hai Lancha traversed the peaks of Dongshijiao—Shizitou, Datieliao, Duangu, Hehuan, and other communities—as far north as the charcoal kilns, capturing and punishing the remaining bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Pressing the assault on the Xiaobantian Mountain stockade, he ranged the peaks of Dongshijiao—Shizitou, Datieliao, Duangu, Hehuan, and other settlements—north as far as the charcoal kilns, capturing and punishing the remaining rebels.

sentences.zh: 五十三年正月，得爽文於老衢崎，檻送京師。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fifty-third year, Shuangwen was taken at Laoquqi and sent to the capital in a caged cart.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the fifty-third year Shuangwen was captured at Laoquqi and sent to the capital in a cage cart.

sentences.zh: 上念海蘭察功，解佩囊賜之。

translations.literal: The Emperor, mindful of Hai Lancha's merit, removed his own purse and bestowed it on him.
translations.idiomatic: Mindful of Hai Lancha's service, the emperor took off his own purse and gave it to him.

sentences.zh: 二月，還兵至南路，自彎里社至極南瑯嶠，執賊渠莊大田，磔於市。

translations.literal: In the second month, returning troops to the southern route, from Wanli Community to Langqiao at the extreme south, he seized the bandit chieftain Zhuang Datian and dismembered him in the marketplace.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, turning south, he ranged from Wanli Community to Langqiao at the island's southern extremity, seized the rebel chieftain Zhuang Datian, and had him dismembered in the marketplace.

sentences.zh: 台灣平，賜紫韁、金黃辮珊瑚朝珠，再圖形紫光閣。

translations.literal: When Taiwan was pacified, he was granted a purple bridle, golden-braided coral court beads, and again had his portrait placed in the Hall of Purple Splendor.
translations.idiomatic: When Taiwan was pacified he received a purple bridle, golden-braided coral court beads, and a second portrait in the Hall of Purple Splendor.

sentences.zh: 五十六年，廓爾喀侵後藏，仍以福康安為將軍，海蘭察為參贊大臣，率巴圖魯侍衛及索倫兵千人往討。

translations.literal: In the fifty-sixth year, Gurkha invaded rear Tibet; Fukang'an was again made general and Hai Lancha participating minister; they led baturu guards and a thousand Solon troops to campaign against them.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-sixth year the Gurkhas invaded rear Tibet. Fukang'an was again made general and Hai Lancha participating minister; they led baturu guards and a thousand Solon troops against them.

sentences.zh: 出西寧，明年三月，抵後藏。

translations.literal: Setting out from Xining, in the third month of the following year they reached rear Tibet.
translations.idiomatic: They marched out from Xining and reached rear Tibet in the third month of the following year.

sentences.zh: 閏四月，抵第哩浪古。

translations.literal: In the intercalary fourth month they reached Dilianggu.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary fourth month they reached Dilianggu.

sentences.zh: 與福康安分往絨轄、聶拉木察地勢，定策自濟嚨進兵。

translations.literal: Together with Fukang'an he went separately to Rongxia and Nielamu to survey the terrain and decided on a plan to advance from Jilong.
translations.idiomatic: He and Fukang'an reconnoitered separately at Rongxia and Nielamu, then settled on advancing from Jilong.

sentences.zh: 海蘭察偕阿滿泰出中路，賊兩碉前後相輔，師奪前碉，賊守後碉不出；

translations.literal: Hai Lancha together with Aman Tai took the center route; two blockhouses front and rear supported each other; the army took the forward blockhouse, but the bandits held the rear blockhouse and would not come out.
translations.idiomatic: Hai Lancha advanced up the center route with Aman Tai. Two blockhouses backed each other; the army seized the forward one, but the enemy clung to the rear blockhouse and refused to come out.

sentences.zh: 督兵毀旁垣入，短兵接，殺賊目三、賊兵二百，進屯擦木。

translations.literal: He directed troops to destroy the side wall and enter; at close quarters they killed three bandit leaders and two hundred bandit soldiers, and advanced to encamp at Camu.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered his men to break through the side wall. In close fighting they killed three enemy leaders and two hundred soldiers, then advanced and encamped at Camu.

sentences.zh: 乘勝克瑪噶爾轄爾甲山梁，賊渠率眾陟山，我兵暫伏，賊至山半，橫擊之，賊且戰且退，海蘭察疾馳下擊賊，斬賊渠七、賊二百餘，俘三十。

translations.literal: Riding victory, they took Maga'erxia'erjia ridge; the bandit chieftain led his force up the mountain; our troops lay briefly in ambush; when the bandits reached mid-slope, they struck them crosswise; the bandits fought while retreating; Hai Lancha galloped down to strike the bandits, beheading seven bandit chieftains and more than two hundred bandits, capturing thirty.
translations.idiomatic: Pressing the victory, they seized Maga'erxia'erjia ridge. The enemy chieftain led his men up the slope; the Qing troops lay in wait until the rebels were halfway up, then struck them from the flank. As the enemy fought their way down, Hai Lancha charged downhill, killing seven chieftains, more than two hundred men, and taking thirty prisoners.

sentences.zh: 海蘭察馬足中槍，上聞，戒以「接仗時宜持重，毋輕冒險」。

translations.literal: Hai Lancha's horse was shot in the leg; when the Emperor heard, he admonished: 'In battle you should be steady and not lightly court danger.'
translations.idiomatic: Hai Lancha's horse was shot in the leg. When word reached the emperor, he cautioned him: 'In battle you must keep steady and not court danger lightly.'

sentences.zh: 師進攻濟嚨官寨，海蘭察與台斐英阿督索倫兵往來衝擊，自醜至亥，克之，斬賊六百，俘二百。

translations.literal: The army advanced to attack the Jilong official stockade; Hai Lancha with Taifeiying'a directed Solon troops in repeated charges from chou to hai, took it, beheaded six hundred bandits, and captured two hundred.
translations.idiomatic: The army advanced on the Jilong chief stockade. Hai Lancha and Taifeiying'a led the Solon troops in repeated assaults from midday until nightfall, captured the place, killed six hundred of the enemy, and took two hundred prisoners.

sentences.zh: 自濟嚨進至索喇拉山，山下有石卡。

translations.literal: Advancing from Jilong to Suolala Mountain, below the mountain was a stone checkpoint.
translations.idiomatic: Marching on from Jilong to Suolala Mountain, they found a stone checkpoint at the foot of the slope.

sentences.zh: 師直攻之，賊棄卡奔。

translations.literal: The army attacked it directly; the bandits abandoned the checkpoint and fled.
translations.idiomatic: The army attacked it head-on; the enemy abandoned the checkpoint and fled.

sentences.zh: 逐至熱索橋，賊撤橋，攻之不及。

translations.literal: Pursuing to Resuo Bridge, the bandits removed the bridge; the attack could not reach them in time.
translations.idiomatic: The pursuit carried to Resuo Bridge, but the enemy had destroyed the bridge and could not be overtaken.

sentences.zh: 海蘭察密令阿滿泰等東越峨綠山，自上流潛渡，賊駭奔，墜河者甚眾。

translations.literal: Hai Lancha secretly ordered Aman Tai and others to cross east over E'lv Mountain and ford secretly upstream; the bandits fled in alarm; very many fell into the river.
translations.idiomatic: Hai Lancha secretly sent Aman Tai and others east over E'lv Mountain to ford upstream by stealth. The enemy fled in panic, and a great many plunged into the river.

sentences.zh: 師悉渡，遂據熱索橋，進至密哩頂，越崇山數重，抵旺噶爾，深入八百七十里，不見賊。

translations.literal: The army all crossed and then occupied Resuo Bridge, advanced to Mili Peak, crossed layer upon layer of lofty mountains, reached Wangga'er, and penetrated eight hundred seventy li without seeing bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Once the whole army had crossed, they held Resuo Bridge and pushed on to Mili Peak, crossing range after range of high mountains until they reached Wangga'er, eight hundred seventy li deep without sighting the enemy.

sentences.zh: 旺噶爾西南有大川橫亙，北曰旺堆，南曰協布魯，迤東為克堆寨，賊各築卡以守。

translations.literal: Southwest of Wangga'er a great river stretched across; north was Wangdui, south was Xiebulu; extending east was Keduizhai; the bandits each built checkpoints to defend.
translations.idiomatic: Southwest of Wangga'er a great river barred the way: Wangdui to the north, Xiebulu to the south, and Keduizhai farther east, each point held by enemy checkpoints.

sentences.zh: 師至旺堆，賊扼河抵禦，不得渡，乃留兵牽賊；

translations.literal: When the army reached Wangdui, the bandits held the river in defense and could not be crossed; troops were left to pin the bandits down.
translations.idiomatic: At Wangdui the enemy held the river line and could not be crossed, so troops were left to pin them in place.

sentences.zh: 密從上游縛木以濟，出賊不意，直薄克堆寨，大敗之。

translations.literal: Secretly they bound logs upstream to cross, took the bandits unawares, and pressed straight on Keduizhai, inflicting a great defeat.
translations.idiomatic: Meanwhile others bound rafts upstream, crossed unobserved, and fell on Keduizhai by surprise, inflicting a crushing defeat.

sentences.zh: 六月，督兵自協布魯進，由噶多東南越雅爾賽拉山，晝夜行，至博爾東拉前山。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, directing troops to advance from Xiebulu, they crossed southeast from Gadu over Ya'ersaila Mountain, marching day and night to reach the forward slope of Bo'erdongla.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month he led the advance from Xiebulu, crossing southeast from Gadu over Ya'ersaila Mountain by forced marches day and night until they reached the forward slope of Bo'erdongla.

sentences.zh: 賊築木城三、石卡七，據要隘，乃轉從山巔下臨賊卡，與阿滿泰上下夾擊，諸城卡盡下；

translations.literal: The bandits built three wooden forts and seven stone checkpoints holding strategic passes; they then turned from the mountain crest to overlook the bandit checkpoints and, with Aman Tai striking from above and below, all the forts and checkpoints fell.
translations.idiomatic: The enemy had thrown up three wooden forts and seven stone checkpoints on the vital ground. The Qing forces swung onto the crest to overlook the positions and, with Aman Tai attacking from above and below, every fort and checkpoint fell.

sentences.zh: 乘勝逐賊至瑪木拉，殺伏賊百餘人。

translations.literal: Riding victory, they pursued the bandits to Mamula and killed more than a hundred ambush troops.
translations.idiomatic: Pressing the pursuit to Mamula, they killed more than a hundred men in ambush.

sentences.zh: 師屯雍雅山，廓爾喀乞降，拒不許。

translations.literal: The army encamped at Yongya Mountain; Gurkha begged to surrender, but this was refused.
translations.idiomatic: The army encamped at Yongya Mountain. The Gurkhas begged to surrender, but the request was refused.

sentences.zh: 七月，進攻噶勒拉山，三道皆勝。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, advancing to attack Galela Mountain, all three routes were victorious.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month they advanced against Galela Mountain and won on all three routes.

sentences.zh: 逐賊至堆補木山，奪其卡。

translations.literal: Pursuing the bandits to Duibumu Mountain, they seized its checkpoint.
translations.idiomatic: Pursuing the enemy to Duibumu Mountain, they seized its checkpoint.

sentences.zh: 山下為帕朗古橫河，賊扼橋以拒。

translations.literal: Below the mountain was the Palanggu transverse river; the bandits held the bridge in defense.
translations.idiomatic: Below lay the Palanggu River; the enemy held the bridge against them.

sentences.zh: 官兵奪橋渡，馳上甲爾古拉山；

translations.literal: The officers and soldiers seized the bridge and crossed, galloping up Jia'ergula Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: The troops stormed the bridge, crossed, and galloped up Jia'ergula Mountain.

sentences.zh: 別兵從上游潛渡，抵集木集山，合軍。

translations.literal: Another detachment secretly forded upstream and reached Jimuji Mountain; the armies united.
translations.idiomatic: Another column forded upstream in secret and reached Jimuji Mountain, where the forces united.

sentences.zh: 賊來侵，往來迎擊，戰兩日夜，越大山二，克木城四、大小石卡十一，戮賊目十三，斃賊六百，俘十七。

translations.literal: The bandits came to attack; they met them in repeated strikes; fighting two days and nights, they crossed two great mountains, took four wooden forts and eleven large and small stone checkpoints, killed thirteen bandit leaders, slew six hundred bandits, and captured seventeen.
translations.idiomatic: When the enemy attacked, they met them in repeated clashes. Fighting two days and two nights, they crossed two great mountains, took four wooden forts and eleven stone checkpoints large and small, killed thirteen enemy leaders, slew six hundred men, and captured seventeen.

sentences.zh: 廓爾喀渠畏懼，力請降，詔許之，進海蘭察一等公。

translations.literal: The Gurkha chieftain was terrified and urgently begged to surrender; an edict permitted it; Hai Lancha was advanced to Duke of the first rank.
translations.idiomatic: The Gurkha chieftain, terrified, urgently sued for peace. An edict accepted the surrender, and Hai Lancha was advanced to first-rank duke.

sentences.zh: 五十八年三月，卒，諡武壯。

translations.literal: In the third month of the fifty-eighth year he died; posthumous title Wuzhuang.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the fifty-eighth year he died and was given the posthumous title Wuzhuang.

sentences.zh: 复圖形紫光閣，甫成，上製贊嗟惜，諭曰：「海蘭察以病卒，例不入昭忠祠。

translations.literal: Again his portrait was placed in the Hall of Purple Splendor; when it was just completed, the Emperor composed a eulogy of regret and instructed: 'Hai Lancha died of illness; by rule he is not entered in the Shrine of Loyalty and Righteousness.
translations.idiomatic: His portrait was again placed in the Hall of Purple Splendor. When it was finished, the emperor composed a lament and said: 'Hai Lancha died of illness; by rule he would not enter the Shrine of Loyalty and Righteousness.

sentences.zh: 念其在軍奮勉，嘗受多傷，加恩入祀。」

translations.literal: Considering that in the army he strove diligently and often received many wounds, grace is extended to enter him in worship.'
translations.idiomatic: Yet considering how hard he fought and how often he was wounded, I extend grace that he be worshipped there.'

sentences.zh: 子安祿，襲公爵，授頭等侍衛。

translations.literal: His son Anlu inherited the ducal title and was appointed first-class imperial bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: His son Anlu inherited the dukedom and was appointed first-class imperial bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶四年，佐經略勒保徵四川教匪，戰屢有功。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of the Jiaqing reign, he assisted Grand Minister Lebao in campaigning against the White Lotus rebels in Sichuan and repeatedly achieved merit in battle.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of the Jiaqing reign he served under Grand Minister Lebao against the White Lotus rebels in Sichuan and won repeated victories.

sentences.zh: 賊渠苟文明等窺開縣，安祿與總兵硃射鬥合軍逐剿，賊不敢東竄。

translations.literal: The bandit chieftains Gou Wenming and others watched for an opening at Kaixian; Anlu together with Brigade-General Zhu She fought in combined columns to pursue and suppress them; the bandits did not dare flee east.
translations.idiomatic: The rebel chieftains Gou Wenming and others watched for a chance to strike Kaixian. Anlu and Brigade-General Zhu She joined forces to hunt them down, and the rebels did not dare break eastward.

sentences.zh: 十一月，與射鬥逐賊枯草坪，乘雨登汪家山殺賊，賊多墜崖死。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, together with Zhu She he pursued the bandits to Kucaoping; taking advantage of rain, they ascended Wangjia Mountain and killed bandits; many bandits fell from the cliffs and died.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month he and Zhu She pursued the rebels to Kucaoping. In the rain they climbed Wangjia Mountain and killed many of the enemy, a great number of whom fell from the cliffs to their deaths.

sentences.zh: 安祿望見數十賊匿山溝，率數騎逐之，賊潰散，獨策馬從其後，數賊自林中出，安祿倉卒中矛死。

translations.literal: Anlu saw several dozen bandits hiding in a mountain ravine; leading several horsemen he pursued them; the bandits scattered; he alone spurred his horse after them; several bandits emerged from the forest; Anlu was struck by a spear in the confusion and died.
translations.idiomatic: Anlu spotted several dozen rebels hiding in a ravine and gave chase with a few horsemen. When the enemy scattered, he rode after them alone. Several men sprang from the woods and, in the confusion, speared him to death.

sentences.zh: 諡壯毅，賜白金千治喪，加騎都尉世職，合前賜騎都尉為三等輕車騎尉。

translations.literal: Posthumous title Zhuangyi; a thousand taels of silver were granted for funeral arrangements; the hereditary office of cavalry commandant was added; together with the previously granted cavalry commandant, he received the third-rank hereditary office of light chariot cavalry captain.
translations.idiomatic: He was given the posthumous title Zhuangyi, a thousand taels of silver for his funeral, and an added hereditary cavalry commandant; together with the earlier grant, his heirs received the third-rank hereditary office of light chariot cavalry captain.

sentences.zh: 是時奎林子惠倫亦戰沒。

translations.literal: At that time Kuilin's son Huilun also died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: About the same time Kuilin's son Huilun also fell in battle.

sentences.zh: 上以二人皆名將子，與烏合亂民戰，沒於行陣，深致惜焉。

translations.literal: The Emperor, because both men were sons of famous generals who died fighting a rabble in the field, expressed deep regret.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor mourned that both were sons of renowned commanders who had perished fighting a disorderly mob in the field.

sentences.zh: 奎林，字直方，富察氏，滿洲鑲黃旗人，承恩公傅文子也。

translations.literal: Kuilin, style Zhifang, of the Fuca clan, a Manchu of the Bordered Yellow Banner, was the son of Duke Cheng'en Fuwen.
translations.idiomatic: Kuilin, whose style was Zhifang, of the Fuca clan, was a Manchu of the Bordered Yellow Banner and son of Duke Cheng'en Fuwen.

sentences.zh: 自拜唐阿襲雲騎尉，​​擢雲麾使，襲承恩公爵，授御前侍衛。

translations.literal: Beginning from the rank of Ba Tang'a, he inherited Cloud Cavalry Captain, was promoted to Cloud Standard Bearer, inherited the dukedom of Cheng'en, and was appointed imperial bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: Starting from the rank of Ba Tang'a, he inherited cloud cavalry captain, was promoted to cloud standard bearer, succeeded to the dukedom of Cheng'en, and was appointed an imperial bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 累遷鑲白旗護軍統領，管理健銳營。

translations.literal: Repeatedly promoted to Colonel of the Bordered White Banner Guard, managing the Elite Vanguard Brigade.
translations.idiomatic: He rose through repeated promotions to colonel of the Bordered White Banner Guard and was put in charge of the Elite Vanguard Brigade.

sentences.zh: 乾隆三十七年，授領隊大臣，從副軍阿桂徵金川，與侍衛和隆武攻納圍山梁，攻當噶爾拉。

translations.literal: In the thirty-seventh year of the Qianlong reign, appointed Leading Minister; followed Deputy General Agui to campaign against Jinchuan; with bodyguard Helongwu attacked Nawei mountain ridge and Dangga'era.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-seventh year of Qianlong he was made leading minister and joined Deputy General Agui in the Jinchuan campaign. With bodyguard Helongwu he assaulted the Nawei ridge and Dangga'era.

sentences.zh: 木果木師潰，命阿桂為定西將軍，召奎林入諮軍事。

translations.literal: When the Muguomu army collapsed, Agui was appointed Pacifier of the West, and Kuilin was summoned to consult on military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: After the disaster at Muguomu, Agui was appointed Pacifier of the West and Kuilin was called in to advise on military affairs.

sentences.zh: 旋命佐副將軍明亮出南路，自墨壟溝進攻得里。

translations.literal: Soon ordered to assist Deputy General Mingliang on the southern route, advancing from Molonggou to attack Deli.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon ordered to serve under Deputy General Mingliang on the southern route, advancing from Molonggou against Deli.

sentences.zh: 賊築碉山嶺，奎林率兵晝伏夜行，至其側，突擊破之。

translations.literal: Bandits built blockhouses on the ridges; Kuilin led troops hiding by day and marching by night, reached their flank, and stormed and broke them.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels had fortified the ridges with blockhouses. Kuilin led his men in daylight concealment and night marches, reached their flank, and stormed the position.

sentences.zh: 攻拉約，夜渡河，鼓譟，克賊壘，遂抵僧格宗，連破石碉，獲軍糧火藥。

translations.literal: Attacked Layue, crossed the river at night with drums and shouts, took the rebel fort, reached Senggezong, successively stormed stone blockhouses, and seized army grain and gunpowder.
translations.idiomatic: At Layue he crossed the river by night with drums and battle cries, carried the rebel fort, and pushed on to Senggezong, where he stormed a series of stone blockhouses and captured army grain and gunpowder.

sentences.zh: 時阿桂复美諾，明亮遣奎林往會師。

translations.literal: At that time Agui had recovered Meinuo; Mingliang sent Kuilin to join forces.
translations.idiomatic: By then Agui had retaken Meinuo, and Mingliang sent Kuilin to link up with him.

sentences.zh: 復從明亮攻斯第，奎林率第一隊兵先佔班得古水泉，與賊持兩晝夜，涉險鏖戰，飛石傷脊。

translations.literal: Again following Mingliang to attack Sidi, Kuilin led the first column to seize Bandegu spring first; fought bandits for two days and nights in perilous ground in fierce battle; wounded in the spine by a flying stone.
translations.idiomatic: He again followed Mingliang against Sidi, leading the first column to seize the Bandegu spring. After two days and nights of fighting in dangerous terrain, he was struck in the spine by a flying rock.

sentences.zh: 兩賊握利刃突前，侍衛珠勒格德射之，殪，餘賊驚逸。

translations.literal: Two bandits wielding sharp blades rushed forward; bodyguard Zhulegede shot them and killed them; the remaining bandits fled in alarm.
translations.idiomatic: Two rebels with drawn blades charged forward; bodyguard Zhulegede shot them down, and the rest fled in panic.

sentences.zh: 上諭嘉奎林勇猛。

translations.literal: The Emperor issued an edict praising Kuilin's bravery.
