translations.idiomatic: The emperor issued an edict commending Kuilin's bravery.

sentences.zh: 攻達爾圖，賊碉綿亙數里，奎林冒雨先登，立拔第一碉。

translations.literal: Attacking Da'ertu, bandit blockhouses stretched for several li; Kuilin in the rain climbed first and immediately took the first blockhouse.
translations.idiomatic: At Da'ertu, where rebel blockhouses stretched for miles along the line, Kuilin climbed first through the rain and instantly carried the leading blockhouse.

sentences.zh: 官軍乘勢疾擊，克碉十五，俘賊目八，獲糧械無算。

translations.literal: The government army pressed the advantage in fierce attack, took fifteen blockhouses, captured eight bandit chieftains, and seized grain and weapons beyond counting.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial troops pressed the advantage, storming fifteen blockhouses, capturing eight rebel leaders, and seizing grain and arms beyond count.

sentences.zh: 復自木剋什山梁進克賊碉一，中槍傷頂，上諭曰：「奎林平日戰甚力，今頂傷中要害。」

translations.literal: Again from Mukeshi mountain ridge advanced and took one bandit blockhouse; shot in the crown of the head; the Emperor instructed: 'Kuilin in ordinary times fights very hard; now wounded in the head, a vital spot.'
translations.idiomatic: Advancing again from the Mukeshi ridge, he took another rebel blockhouse but was shot in the crown of the head. The emperor said: 'Kuilin has always fought with great force; now he is wounded in the head, a vital spot.'

sentences.zh: 時富德軍於馬爾那，令奎林代防，即以富德佐明亮擊賊。

translations.literal: At that time Fude's army was at Ma'erna; Kuilin was ordered to replace him in defense, and Fude was put under Mingliang to strike bandits.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Fude's force was at Ma'erna. Kuilin was ordered to hold the position in Fude's place while Fude was assigned to Mingliang to strike the rebels.

sentences.zh: 旋授鑲紅旗漢軍都統。

translations.literal: Soon appointed Lieutenant-General of the Bordered Red Banner Chinese Army.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon appointed lieutenant-general of the Bordered Red Banner Chinese Army.

sentences.zh: 傷愈，復從明亮攻宜喜。

translations.literal: When his wound healed, again followed Mingliang to attack Yixi.
translations.idiomatic: After he recovered from his wound, he again followed Mingliang against Yixi.

sentences.zh: 阿桂遣領侍衛內大臣海蘭察會奎林度地勢，約兩軍隔河夾擊，直搗勒烏圍。

translations.literal: Agui sent Leading Bodyguard Grand Minister Hai Lancha to meet Kuilin and survey the terrain; they planned a two-army pincer across the river, striking straight at Lewuwei.
translations.idiomatic: Agui sent leading bodyguard and grand minister Hai Lancha to join Kuilin in reconnoitering the ground. They agreed that the two armies would attack from opposite banks of the river and drive straight at Lewuwei.

sentences.zh: 勒烏圍、噶拉依，兩金川渠所居地也。

translations.literal: Lewuwei and Gela'i were where the two Jinchuan chieftains resided.
translations.idiomatic: Lewuwei and Gela'i were the seats of the two Jinchuan chieftains.

sentences.zh: 奎林分攻甲索，又自薩克薩谷攻得楞，賊棄碉竄，乘勝追躡，墮崖死者相枕籍。

translations.literal: Kuilin divided forces to attack Jiasuo, and from Saksa Valley attacked Deleng; bandits abandoned blockhouses and fled; pressing the victory in pursuit, corpses piled on the cliffs from those who fell.
translations.idiomatic: Kuilin divided his force to attack Jiasuo and, from Saksa Valley, struck Deleng. The rebels abandoned their blockhouses and fled; in the pursuit many tumbled from the cliffs until the dead lay piled upon one another.

sentences.zh: 攻基木斯丹當噶，奪碉二、卡九，又奪茹寨麥田十餘裡，賜繃武巴圖魯名號。

translations.literal: Attacked Jimusidandangga, seized two blockhouses and nine checkpoints, also seized Ruzhai wheat fields for more than ten li, and was granted the title Bengwu Baturu.
translations.idiomatic: He attacked Jimusidandangga, capturing two blockhouses and nine checkpoints, and also took more than ten li of wheat fields at Ruzhai. He was granted the baturu title Bengwu Baturu.

sentences.zh: 复趨噶西喇嘛寺，拔沙爾尼溝碉卡。

translations.literal: Again hurried to Gaxi Lama Temple and stormed the blockhouses and checkpoints at Sha'erni Gully.
translations.idiomatic: He then pressed on to Gaxi Lama Temple and stormed the blockhouses and checkpoints in Sha'erni Gully.

sentences.zh: 阿桂破勒烏圍，奎林偕明亮、和隆武等攻扎烏古山，未克，請益兵。

translations.literal: Agui broke Lewuwei; Kuilin with Mingliang, Helongwu, and others attacked Zhawugu Mountain, did not take it, and requested reinforcements.
translations.idiomatic: After Agui broke Lewuwei, Kuilin joined Mingliang, Helongwu, and others in an assault on Zhawugu Mountain. When it did not fall, he asked for more troops.

sentences.zh: 上諭奎林、和隆武：「毋以勇往好勝，愧激輕進。

translations.literal: The Emperor instructed Kuilin and Helongwu: 'Do not, through bold advance and love of victory, be shamed into rash advance.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor admonished Kuilin and Helongwu: 'Do not let boldness and the urge to win shame you into reckless advance.

sentences.zh: 雖云'不入虎穴，焉得虎子'；

translations.literal: Although one says, "If you do not enter the tiger's den, how can you catch the tiger cub";
translations.idiomatic: True, it is said that "if you do not enter the tiger's den, you cannot catch the tiger cub";

sentences.zh: 亦當番度機要，權利害而行，不可冒昧。」

translations.literal: you must also repeatedly weigh the strategic essentials and act according to advantage and harm; you must not be rash.'
translations.idiomatic: yet you must also weigh the strategic essentials again and again and act according to advantage and harm. You must not be rash.'

sentences.zh: 旋自什扎古進兵，偕和隆武自山溝潛行，登其巔，碉內賊無一脫者。

translations.literal: Soon advancing from Shizhagu, together with Helongwu he secretly marched through a mountain gully, climbed the summit, and not one bandit in the blockhouses escaped.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he advanced from Shizhagu. With Helongwu he stole up a mountain gully to the summit, and not one rebel in the blockhouses escaped.

sentences.zh: 上諭明亮、奎林、和隆武：「宜黽勉立勳，毋讓西路專美！

translations.literal: The Emperor instructed Mingliang, Kuilin, and Helongwu: 'You should strive diligently to establish merit and not let the western route alone win all the glory!
translations.idiomatic: The emperor told Mingliang, Kuilin, and Helongwu: 'You should exert yourselves to win distinction and not let the western route alone carry off all the credit!

sentences.zh: 但當度利害，不可但知輕進。」

translations.literal: But you must weigh advantage and harm; you must not know only rash advance.'
translations.idiomatic: But you must weigh advantage and harm; you must not know only how to charge ahead.'

sentences.zh: 進克扎烏古山梁。

translations.literal: Advanced and took Zhawugu mountain ridge.
translations.idiomatic: They then advanced and carried the Zhawugu ridge.

sentences.zh: 再進據納木迪、斯底葉安，奪三十餘寨。

translations.literal: Advancing again, they occupied Namudi and Sidiye'an and seized more than thirty stockades.
translations.idiomatic: Pressing forward, they occupied Namudi and Sidiye'an and captured more than thirty stockades.

sentences.zh: 又自耳得谷下擊賊碉卡，斃賊百餘。

translations.literal: Again from Erde Valley they descended to strike bandit blockhouses and checkpoints, killing more than a hundred bandits.
translations.idiomatic: From Erde Valley they descended to strike rebel blockhouses and checkpoints, killing more than a hundred of the enemy.

sentences.zh: 復自碾佔進攻，達撒谷，拔碉卡三十，斃賊百。

translations.literal: Again from Nianzhan advanced to attack Dasagu, stormed thirty blockhouses and checkpoints, and killed a hundred bandits.
translations.idiomatic: From Nianzhan he advanced on Dasagu, stormed thirty blockhouses and checkpoints, and killed a hundred rebels.

sentences.zh: 趨獨古木思得，賊潰，平山上下八十餘寨。

translations.literal: Hurried to Dugumuside; bandits collapsed; pacified more than eighty stockades above and below the mountain.
translations.idiomatic: He pushed on to Dugumuside, where the rebels broke. More than eighty stockades up and down the mountain were pacified.

sentences.zh: 師經乃當，降其渠。

translations.literal: The army passed Naidang and the chieftain submitted.
translations.idiomatic: When the army reached Naidang, the local chieftain surrendered.

sentences.zh: 攻甲雜，俘賊酋，降其眾千餘。

translations.literal: Attacked Jiaza, captured the bandit chief, and the masses numbering more than a thousand submitted.
translations.idiomatic: At Jiaza he captured the rebel chief, and more than a thousand of their followers surrendered.

sentences.zh: 克卡拉爾，抵舍斯滿，賊出降。

translations.literal: Took Kala'er, reached Shesiman, and the bandits came out and submitted.
translations.idiomatic: He took Kala'er, reached Shesiman, and the rebels came out to surrender.

sentences.zh: 奎林繞山巔行三百里，至底角河沿，撫定寨落數百，遂與阿桂軍合圍噶拉依。

translations.literal: Kuilin circled three hundred li along the mountain crest to the Dijiao riverside, pacified several hundred stockade settlements, and then joined Agui's army in besieging Gela'i.
translations.idiomatic: Kuilin marched three hundred li along the mountain crest to the Dijiao riverside, pacified several hundred stockade settlements, and then joined Agui's army in the siege of Gela'i.

sentences.zh: 上加奎林一等男，命其子崇倫承襲，並賜雙眼花翎。

translations.literal: The Emperor raised Kuilin to Baron of the First Rank, ordered his son Chonglun to inherit the title, and also granted the double-eyed peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor raised Kuilin to first-rank baron, ordered his son Chonglun to inherit the title, and granted him the double-eyed peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 遂俘金川酋索諾木。

translations.literal: Thereupon the Jinchuan chieftain Suonuomu was captured.
translations.idiomatic: The Jinchuan chieftain Suonuomu was then taken prisoner.

sentences.zh: 師還，凱旋，上郊勞，賜文綺十二、銀五百、御用鞍轡馬一。

translations.literal: When the army returned in triumph, the Emperor received them with suburban rites of welcome and granted twelve rolls of patterned silk, five hundred taels of silver, and one imperial saddle and bridle horse.
translations.idiomatic: When the army returned in triumph, the emperor welcomed them with suburban rites and granted twelve rolls of patterned silk, five hundred taels of silver, and an imperial horse with saddle and bridle.

sentences.zh: 圖形紫光閣，列前五十功臣。

translations.literal: His portrait was placed in the Hall of Purple Splendor among the first fifty meritorious ministers.
translations.idiomatic: His portrait was placed in the Hall of Purple Splendor among the fifty foremost meritorious ministers.

sentences.zh: 授右翼前鋒統領，擢理籓院尚書。

translations.literal: Appointed Colonel of the Right Vanguard and promoted to Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed colonel of the right vanguard and promoted to minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.

sentences.zh: 四十五年，出為烏魯木齊都統。

translations.literal: In the forty-fifth year, sent out as Commandant of Urumqi.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-fifth year he was posted as commandant of Urumqi.

sentences.zh: 驍騎校常福杖斃披甲多羅，奎林論劾，上以多羅不孝，罪當死，責奎林誤劾。

translations.literal: Cavalry Commandant Changfu beat to death the armored bondsman Duoluo; Kuilin memorialized to impeach him; the Emperor, holding that Duoluo was unfilial and deserved death, rebuked Kuilin for a mistaken impeachment.
translations.idiomatic: Cavalry Commandant Changfu beat the armored bondsman Duoluo to death. Kuilin impeached him, but the emperor ruled that Duoluo had been unfilial and deserved death, and rebuked Kuilin for a mistaken accusation.

sentences.zh: 改授烏里雅蘇台將軍。

translations.literal: Transferred to General of Uliastai.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to general of Uliastai.

sentences.zh: 坐在烏魯木齊失察各州縣浮報糧值，命以公爵畀其叔傅玉承襲。

translations.literal: Convicted for failing while at Urumqi to detect inflated grain prices reported by the various prefectures and counties; ordered that the ducal title be given to his uncle Fu Yu to inherit.
translations.idiomatic: He was found guilty of failing, while at Urumqi, to detect inflated grain-price reports from the prefectures and counties, and was ordered to yield the ducal title to his uncle Fu Yu.

sentences.zh: 复授烏魯木齊都統。

translations.literal: Again appointed Commandant of Urumqi.
translations.idiomatic: He was again appointed commandant of Urumqi.

sentences.zh: 遷伊犁將軍。

translations.literal: Transferred to General of Ili.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to general of Ili.

sentences.zh: 奎林貴戚有軍功，耆酒躁急。

translations.literal: Kuilin, a noble relative with military merit, was fond of wine and quick-tempered.
translations.idiomatic: Kuilin was a kinsman of the imperial house with military merit, but he was fond of wine and hot-tempered.

sentences.zh: 五十二年，參贊海祿疏劾，上命烏魯木齊都統永鐸勘奏。

translations.literal: In the fifty-second year, Participating Minister Hailu memorialized to impeach him; the Emperor ordered Urumqi Commandant Yong Duo to investigate and report.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-second year Participating Minister Hailu impeached him in a memorial, and the emperor ordered Urumqi Commandant Yong Duo to investigate and report.

sentences.zh: 逮至京師，命諸皇子、軍機大臣會刑部按治，獄成，奎林坐擅殺罪人，擬杖；

translations.literal: Brought to the capital, the Emperor ordered the princes and Grand Council ministers to join the Board of Punishments in trying the case; when the case was concluded, Kuilin was convicted of unauthorized killing of a criminal and sentenced to beating with the stick;
translations.idiomatic: Brought to the capital, he was tried jointly by the princes, Grand Council ministers, and the Board of Punishments. When the case was concluded, Kuilin was found guilty of unauthorized killing and sentenced to beating with the stick;

sentences.zh: 海祿所劾不盡實，亦有罪，坐誣告，死罪，未決，擬流；

translations.literal: Hailu's impeachment was not entirely substantiated, and he too was guilty; convicted of false accusation, a capital offense, the sentence not yet decided, he was provisionally sentenced to exile;
translations.idiomatic: Hailu's charges were not wholly substantiated, and he too was guilty. Convicted of false accusation—a capital crime—his sentence was not yet fixed, but exile was provisionally proposed;

sentences.zh: 帝以奎林孝賢皇后侄，而祿海所論劾不盡虛，擬罪乃反重，失平，命俱奪職，在上虞備用處拜唐阿上效力。

translations.literal: The Emperor, because Kuilin was a nephew of Empress Xiaoxian and Hailu's impeachment was not entirely groundless, held that the proposed punishments were instead too severe and inequitable; ordered both stripped of office and to serve at the Shangyu reserve post of Ba Tang'a.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor noted that Kuilin was a nephew of Empress Xiaoxian and that Hailu's impeachment was not wholly groundless. He held the proposed sentences too heavy and inequitable, stripped both men of office, and ordered them to serve at the Shangyu reserve post of Ba Tang'a.

sentences.zh: 旋授奎林藍翎侍衛，再遷台灣鎮總兵。

translations.literal: Soon Kuilin was appointed Blue Plume Bodyguard and again promoted to Brigade-General of Taiwan.
translations.idiomatic: Kuilin was soon made a blue-plume bodyguard and later promoted to brigade-general of Taiwan.

sentences.zh: 時林爽文亂甫平，多盜，為民害。

translations.literal: At that time the Lin Shuangwen rebellion had just been pacified; bandits were many and harmed the people.
translations.idiomatic: The Lin Shuangwen rebellion had just been suppressed, but bandits remained numerous and preyed on the people.

sentences.zh: 上欲嚴懲之，諭奎林：「勿拘泥，勿姑息，有犯必懲。」

translations.literal: The Emperor wished to punish them severely and instructed Kuilin: 'Do not be bound by convention; do not be indulgent; whoever offends must be punished.'
translations.idiomatic: The emperor wanted them punished severely and told Kuilin: 'Do not be bound by convention; do not be indulgent; whoever offends must be punished.

sentences.zh: 奎林屢捕治劇盜，复論誅裨將坐贓及營兵之為盜者，稱上旨，加提督銜。

translations.literal: Kuilin repeatedly captured and punished major bandits; again memorialized requesting execution of a deputy general convicted of corruption and camp soldiers who had turned bandit; citing the imperial intent, he was given the rank of provincial military commander.
translations.idiomatic: Kuilin repeatedly captured and punished major bandits, and also memorialized for the execution of a deputy general convicted of corruption and of camp soldiers who had turned to robbery. Citing the imperial intent, he was granted the rank of provincial military commander.

sentences.zh: 五十六年，擢福建水師提督。

translations.literal: In the fifty-sixth year, promoted to Admiral of the Fujian Navy.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-sixth year he was promoted to admiral of the Fujian navy.

sentences.zh: 師徵廓爾喀，改授成都將軍、參贊大臣，帥師入藏。

translations.literal: When the army campaigned against Gurkha, he was transferred to General of Chengdu and Participating Minister, commanding troops into Tibet.
translations.idiomatic: When the army marched against Gurkha, he was reassigned as general of Chengdu and participating minister, leading troops into Tibet.

sentences.zh: 五十七年，行至江卡，疽發於頂，遂卒，諡武毅。

translations.literal: In the fifty-seventh year, reaching Jiangka, an abscess broke out on his crown and he thereupon died; posthumous title Wuyi.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-seventh year, while en route at Jiangka, an abscess broke out on his crown and he died. He was given the posthumous title Wuyi.

sentences.zh: 珠勒格德，鈕祜祿氏，滿洲正白旗人。

translations.literal: Zhulegede, of the Niohuru clan, a Manchu of the Plain White Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Zhulegede, of the Niohuru clan, was a Manchu of the Plain White Banner.

sentences.zh: 以三等侍衛從軍。

translations.literal: As a third-class bodyguard he followed the army.
translations.idiomatic: He joined the campaign as a third-class bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 其救奎林也，上命擢一等侍衛，賜號扎克博巴圖魯。

translations.literal: For his rescue of Kuilin, the Emperor ordered him promoted to first-class bodyguard and granted the title Zhakebo Baturu.
translations.idiomatic: For saving Kuilin, the emperor ordered him promoted to first-class bodyguard and granted him the baturu title Zhakebo Baturu.

sentences.zh: 戰於木剋什，據水卡，斷賊汲道，設伏以待。

translations.literal: Fighting at Mukeshi, he held a water checkpoint, cut off the bandits' route to draw water, and set an ambush to wait.
translations.idiomatic: At Mukeshi he seized a water checkpoint, cut off the rebels' access to water, and laid an ambush.

sentences.zh: 賊乘霧分道來犯，守碉兵御之，伏起；

translations.literal: Bandits took advantage of fog to attack by separate routes; troops defending the blockhouses met them, and the ambush rose;
translations.idiomatic: The rebels used fog to attack in separate columns. The troops holding the blockhouses met them, and the ambush force sprang up;

sentences.zh: 賊復自山下援，珠勒格德突入陣，刃三人，大敗之，遂克木剋什山下碉。

translations.literal: bandits again sent reinforcements from below the mountain; Zhulegede burst into the formation, cut down three men, routed them utterly, and thereupon took the blockhouse below Mukeshi.
translations.idiomatic: when rebel reinforcements came up from below the mountain, Zhulegede charged into the formation, cut down three men, and routed them completely, thereby taking the blockhouse below Mukeshi.

sentences.zh: 復與都統和隆武等襲取日旁山後碉十餘，日旁近勒烏圍，賊碉寨相望，後路必爭地也。

translations.literal: Again with Lieutenant-General Helongwu and others he stormed more than ten blockhouses behind Ribang Mountain; Ribang was near Lewuwei, bandit blockhouses and stockades faced one another, and the rear route was ground both sides had to contest.
translations.idiomatic: He again joined Lieutenant-General Helongwu and others in storming more than ten blockhouses behind Ribang Mountain. Ribang lay near Lewuwei, where rebel blockhouses and stockades stood face to face; control of the rear route was ground both sides had to fight for.

sentences.zh: 授正紅旗蒙古副都統。

translations.literal: Appointed Deputy Lieutenant-General of the Plain Red Banner Mongols.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed deputy lieutenant-general of the Plain Red Banner Mongols.

sentences.zh: 奎林攻什扎古，珠勒格德與和隆武設伏瑯谷，奎林兵至，夾擊，破木城；

translations.literal: When Kuilin attacked Shizhagu, Zhulegede with Helongwu set an ambush in Lang Valley; when Kuilin's troops arrived, they attacked from both sides and broke the wooden fort;
translations.idiomatic: When Kuilin attacked Shizhagu, Zhulegede and Helongwu lay in ambush in Lang Valley. When Kuilin's troops arrived, they struck from both sides and broke the wooden fort;

sentences.zh: 進攻扎烏古，克賊碉四、卡八。

translations.literal: advancing to attack Zhawugu, they took four bandit blockhouses and eight checkpoints.
translations.idiomatic: then advanced on Zhawugu and captured four rebel blockhouses and eight checkpoints.

sentences.zh: 自日新滿至巴扎木，賊碉林立，珠勒格德與和隆武分兵進，連克賊碉十七。

translations.literal: From Rixinman to Bazhamu, bandit blockhouses stood in dense array; Zhulegede with Helongwu divided the force and advanced, successively taking seventeen bandit blockhouses.
translations.idiomatic: From Rixinman to Bazhamu the rebel blockhouses stood thick on the ground. Zhulegede and Helongwu divided their force and advanced, storming seventeen blockhouses in succession.

sentences.zh: 金川平，圖形紫光閣，御製贊猶及救奎林事。

translations.literal: When Jinchuan was pacified, his portrait was placed in the Hall of Purple Splendor; the imperially composed eulogy still mentions the matter of saving Kuilin.
translations.idiomatic: When Jinchuan was pacified, his portrait was placed in the Hall of Purple Splendor, and the emperor's own eulogy still recalled his rescue of Kuilin.

sentences.zh: 尋卒。

translations.literal: Soon he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died soon afterward.

sentences.zh: 和隆武，馬佳氏，滿洲正黃旗人，寧夏將軍和起子也。

translations.literal: Helongwu, of the Majia clan, a Manchu of the Plain Yellow Banner, was the son of Ningxia General Heqi.
translations.idiomatic: Helongwu, of the Majia clan, was a Manchu of the Plain Yellow Banner and son of Ningxia General Heqi.

sentences.zh: 初隸鑲藍旗，以和隆武功，高宗命以本佐領抬入正黃旗。

translations.literal: Originally registered in the Bordered Blue Banner; because of Helongwu's merit, Emperor Gaozong ordered him raised with his company captaincy into the Plain Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: He had originally belonged to the Bordered Blue Banner; because of Helongwu's merit, Emperor Gaozong ordered him raised, with his company captaincy, into the Plain Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 凡抬旗，或以功，或以恩，或以佐領，或以族，或以支，皆出特命。

translations.literal: Whenever banner-raising occurred, it might be for merit, favor, company captaincy, clan, or branch—all by special order.
translations.idiomatic: Banner-raising might be granted for merit, favor, company captaincy, clan, or branch line—but always by special imperial order.

sentences.zh: 和隆武襲一等子爵，授三等侍衛。

translations.literal: Helongwu inherited the first-class viscountcy and was appointed third-class bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: Helongwu inherited a first-class viscountcy and was appointed third-class bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 乾隆三十七年，從護軍統領明亮徵金川，自墨壟溝攻甲爾木山梁。

translations.literal: In the thirty-seventh year of the Qianlong reign, followed Colonel Mingliang to campaign against Jinchuan, advancing from Molonggou to attack Ji'ermu mountain ridge.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-seventh year of Qianlong he followed Colonel Mingliang against Jinchuan, advancing from Molonggou to assault the Ji'ermu ridge.

sentences.zh: 師分道而進，和隆武為領隊侍衛，明亮攻美諾喇嘛寺，和隆武傍水夾攻，賊潰而復聚，盡殲之，夜克美諾諸碉寨，復分攻納圍正面山梁，敗賊於鳩寨，奪碉五十餘，遷鑲藍旗蒙古副都統。

translations.literal: The army advanced by separate routes; Helongwu served as leading bodyguard; Mingliang attacked Meinuo Lama Temple; Helongwu attacked from the flank along the water; bandits collapsed and then regathered and were utterly annihilated; by night took all Meinuo blockhouses and stockades; again divided forces to attack the Nawei front mountain ridge; defeated bandits at Jiuzhai; seized more than fifty blockhouses; transferred to Deputy Lieutenant-General of the Bordered Blue Banner Mongols.
translations.idiomatic: The army advanced in separate columns. Helongwu served as leading bodyguard while Mingliang assaulted Meinuo Lama Temple and Helongwu attacked from the flank along the water. The rebels broke, regrouped, and were wiped out; by night all the Meinuo blockhouses and stockades fell. They then divided forces against the Nawei front ridge, defeated the enemy at Jiuzhai, and captured more than fifty blockhouses. Helongwu was transferred to deputy lieutenant-general of the Bordered Blue Banner Mongols.

sentences.zh: 旋收僧格宗。

translations.literal: Soon recovered Senggezong.
translations.idiomatic: He soon recovered Senggezong.

sentences.zh: 從富德攻克絨布寨北沃什山、摩格、孟格、里格、穆圖德宗，進攻卡角。

translations.literal: Following Fude, took north of Rongbu Stockade Woshishan, Moge, Mengge, Lige, and Mutudezong, and advanced to attack Kajiao.
translations.idiomatic: Following Fude, he captured north of Rongbu Stockade Woshishan, Moge, Mengge, Lige, and Mutudezong, then advanced against Kajiao.

sentences.zh: 從奎林等取斯第，賊迎戰，和隆武麾眾盪決，矢盡，以矛鬥，被創，賜玉搬指、荷包。

translations.literal: Following Kuilin and others in taking Sidi, bandits came out to fight; Helongwu commanded the troops in a sweeping charge; arrows exhausted, fought with spears; wounded; granted jade thumb-ring and purse.
translations.idiomatic: Following Kuilin and others against Sidi, he met rebels coming out to fight. Helongwu led a sweeping charge; when his arrows were spent he fought with spears, was wounded, and received a jade thumb-ring and purse.

sentences.zh: 進攻克木剋什第一碉，賜黃馬褂。

translations.literal: Advancing, took the first Mukeshi blockhouse; granted a yellow riding jacket.
translations.idiomatic: In the advance he carried the first Mukeshi blockhouse and was granted a yellow riding jacket.

sentences.zh: 師攻日旁，和隆武自周叟繞出其後，突入碉，賊驚潰，槍石不及施，短刃相搏，循山逐賊碉十餘，隳二百餘，日旁賊殲焉。

translations.literal: The army attacked Ribang; Helongwu from Zhou'ao circled behind them, burst into a blockhouse; bandits collapsed in alarm; guns and stones could not be deployed; short blades fought hand to hand; following the mountain he pursued bandit blockhouses for more than ten, destroyed more than two hundred; the Ribang bandits were annihilated.
translations.idiomatic: When the army attacked Ribang, Helongwu circled from Zhou'ao to strike the rear, burst into a blockhouse, and threw the rebels into panic. Guns and stones could not be brought to bear, and the fight came to close quarters with short blades. He pursued along the mountain for more than ten rebel blockhouses and destroyed more than two hundred; the Ribang rebels were annihilated.

sentences.zh: 复偕珠勒格德攻谷爾堤諸地碉寨，盡克之。

translations.literal: Again with Zhulegede attacked the blockhouses and stockades at Gu'erti and other places, taking them all.
translations.idiomatic: He again joined Zhulegede in storming the blockhouses and stockades at Gu'erti and elsewhere, capturing them all.

sentences.zh: 上屢詔嘉眾，授正藍旗蒙古都統。

translations.literal: The Emperor repeatedly issued edicts praising the troops and appointed him Lieutenant-General of the Plain Blue Banner Mongols.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor repeatedly issued edicts praising the troops and appointed him lieutenant-general of the Plain Blue Banner Mongols.

sentences.zh: 進攻得楞以南碉卡，又進攻額爾替山梁，殺賊甚眾。

translations.literal: Advanced to attack blockhouses and checkpoints south of Deleng, and again advanced to attack the E'erti mountain ridge, killing very many bandits.
translations.idiomatic: He advanced against blockhouses and checkpoints south of Deleng, then pressed on to the E'erti ridge, killing large numbers of rebels.

sentences.zh: 賊據石真噶，和隆武與奎林乘勝運砲，軍甚囂，分隊突出攻據之，賊奔潰。

translations.literal: Bandits held Shizhen'ga; Helongwu with Kuilin, pressing the victory, transported cannon; the army was very clamorous; divided teams burst forth to attack and seize it; bandits fled in collapse.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels held Shizhen'ga. Helongwu and Kuilin, pressing their advantage, hauled up cannon amid great clamor from the army. Divided teams charged out, seized the position, and the rebels broke and fled.

sentences.zh: 四十年七月，阿桂師逼勒烏圍，而和隆武與明亮、奎林合軍出北路，自扎烏古山進。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the fortieth year, Agui's army pressed Lewuwei, while Helongwu with Mingliang and Kuilin combined forces on the northern route, advancing from Zhawugu Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the fortieth year Agui's army closed on Lewuwei while Helongwu, Mingliang, and Kuilin united on the northern route and advanced from Zhawugu Mountain.

sentences.zh: 語已具奎林傳。

translations.literal: The account is already given in Kuilin's biography.
translations.idiomatic: The account is already given in Kuilin's biography.

sentences.zh: 四十一年，金川平，進和隆武三等果勇侯，賜雙眼花翎。

translations.literal: In the forty-first year, Jinchuan pacified, Helongwu was advanced to third-class Marquis of Guoyong and granted the double-eyed peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-first year, with Jinchuan pacified, Helongwu was raised to third-class Marquis of Guoyong and granted the double-eyed peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 師還，賜御用鞍轡馬一，並賚銀幣。

translations.literal: When the army returned, granted one imperial saddle and bridle horse, and also bestowed silver and coins.
translations.idiomatic: When the army returned he received an imperial horse with saddle and bridle, along with silver and coins.

sentences.zh: 圖形紫光閣，列前五十功臣。

translations.literal: His portrait was placed in the Hall of Purple Splendor among the first fifty meritorious ministers.
translations.idiomatic: His portrait was placed in the Hall of Purple Splendor among the fifty foremost meritorious ministers.

sentences.zh: 出為寧夏將軍，移吉林將軍。

translations.literal: Sent out as General of Ningxia, transferred to General of Jilin.
translations.idiomatic: He was posted as general of Ningxia and later transferred to general of Jilin.

sentences.zh: 卒，諡壯毅。

translations.literal: Died; posthumous title Zhuangyi.
translations.idiomatic: He died and was given the posthumous title Zhuangyi.

sentences.zh: 額森特，台褚勒氏，滿洲正白旗人。

translations.literal: Esente, of the Taichule clan, a Manchu of the Plain White Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Esente, of the Taichule clan, was a Manchu of the Plain White Banner.

sentences.zh: 以前鋒馬甲從征伊犁。

translations.literal: As a vanguard armored cavalryman he followed the campaign against Ili.
translations.idiomatic: As a vanguard armored cavalryman he joined the Ili campaign.

sentences.zh: 右部哈薩克與塔什罕相攻，參贊大臣富德使額森特諭哈薩克內附，使入覲，額森特護至京師。

translations.literal: The Right Wing Kazakhs and Tashkent were attacking one another; Participating Minister Fude sent Esente to instruct the Kazakhs to submit internally and come to audience; Esente escorted them to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: When the Right Wing Kazakhs and Tashkent were at war, Participating Minister Fude sent Esente to urge the Kazakhs to submit and come to court. Esente escorted them to the capital.

sentences.zh: 擢藍翎侍衛。

translations.literal: Promoted to Blue Plume Bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to blue-plume bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 遷二等侍衛。

translations.literal: Promoted to second-class bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to second-class bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 乾隆三十四年，從經略大學士傅恆徵緬甸，攻老官屯，賊出戰，額森特率索倫兵擊敗之。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fourth year of the Qianlong reign, following Grand Secretary and Campaign Commander Fu Heng against Burma, at the attack on Laoguantun the rebels came out to fight; Esente led Solon troops and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 34, following Grand Secretary Fu Heng's Burma campaign, he fought at Laoguantun when the enemy sallied forth. Esente led Solon troops and drove them back.

sentences.zh: 三十六年，從定邊右副將軍溫福徵小金川，攻巴朗拉，奪其東山峰，毀碉，賜號丹巴巴圖魯。

translations.literal: In the thirty-sixth year, following Right Pacification Vice-General Wen Fu against Lesser Jinchuan, attacked Balangla, seized its eastern mountain peak, destroyed blockhouses, and was granted the title Danbaba Baturu.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-sixth year he joined Right Pacification Vice-General Wen Fu against Lesser Jinchuan, stormed Balangla, took its eastern peak, destroyed the blockhouses, and received the baturu title Danbaba Baturu.

sentences.zh: 師取達木巴宗，額森特由別道出山北，連破碉卡。

translations.literal: When the army took Damubazong, Esente by a separate route came out north of the mountain and successively stormed blockhouses and checkpoints.
translations.idiomatic: When the army captured Damubazong, Esente took a separate route north of the mountain and in succession broke through blockhouses and checkpoints.

sentences.zh: 至資哩，合師，奪北山。

translations.literal: Reaching Zili, he united with the main force and seized North Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: At Zili he joined the combined army and took North Mountain.

sentences.zh: 賊乘夜築卡，將兵邀擊，賊數百踵至，三卻三進，額森特中槍，力擊敗之，遂克資哩。

translations.literal: Bandits built checkpoints by night; he led troops to intercept; several hundred bandits followed in succession; three times they fell back and three times advanced; Esente was struck by a musket but fought fiercely and defeated them, thus taking Zili.
translations.idiomatic: The enemy threw up checkpoints overnight. Esente led an ambush but hundreds of rebels pressed in. Three times his men gave ground and three times they pushed forward. Though shot, Esente fought on until the position fell and Zili was taken.

sentences.zh: 复策取普爾瑪寨。

translations.literal: Again he planned to take Pu'erma stockade.
translations.idiomatic: He then plotted the capture of Pu'erma stockade.

sentences.zh: 攻東瑪，連戰敗賊，擢頭等侍衛。

translations.literal: Attacking Dongma, he repeatedly defeated the bandits in battle and was promoted to first-class bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: At Dongma he defeated the enemy in successive engagements and was promoted to first-class bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 賊分兩道出戰，伏兵逆擊，賊大敗；

translations.literal: The bandits came out to fight on two routes; he set an ambush for a counter-strike and the bandits suffered a great defeat.
translations.idiomatic: When the rebels emerged on two routes he laid an ambush and counterattacked, routing them completely.

sentences.zh: 薄其碉，身被創，大呼殺賊，遂克東瑪。

translations.literal: Pressing their blockhouses, he was wounded, shouted loudly to kill bandits, and thus took Dongma.
translations.idiomatic: Closing on their blockhouses he was wounded but shouted for his men to kill the enemy, and Dongma fell.

sentences.zh: 進克美美卡，拔路頂宗山碉，授鑲黃旗蒙古副都統。

translations.literal: Advancing he took Meimeika, stormed the Ludingzong mountain blockhouse, and was appointed Mongol deputy lieutenant-general of the Bordered Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: He advanced to take Meimeika, carried the blockhouse on Ludingzong Mountain, and was appointed Mongol deputy lieutenant-general of the Bordered Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 至博爾根，奪山巔大寨。

translations.literal: Reaching Bo'ergen, he seized the great stockade on the mountain summit.
translations.idiomatic: At Bo'ergen he stormed the great stockade on the summit.

sentences.zh: 夜渡水，仰攻納拉覺山，克碉十二、卡十五。

translations.literal: Crossing water by night, he attacked upward at Nalajue Mountain, taking twelve blockhouses and fifteen checkpoints.
translations.idiomatic: By night he crossed the water and assaulted Nalajue Mountain from below, capturing twelve blockhouses and fifteen checkpoints.

sentences.zh: 擊格實迪，破公雅山。

translations.literal: Striking Geshidi, he broke Gongya Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: He struck Geshidi and broke Gongya Mountain.

sentences.zh: 逾木爾​​古山麓，取溝內寨卡，據嘉巴山，授領隊大臣。

translations.literal: Crossing the foot of Mu'ergu Mountain, he took stockades and checkpoints within the ravine, held Jiaba Mountain, and was appointed leading minister.
translations.idiomatic: Crossing the lower slopes of Mu'ergu Mountain he cleared stockades and checkpoints in the gorge, seized Jiaba Mountain, and was appointed leading minister.

sentences.zh: 小金川平，復從將軍溫福至功噶爾拉山。

translations.literal: When Lesser Jinchuan was pacified, he again followed General Wen Fu to Gongga'erla Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: After Lesser Jinchuan was pacified he again followed General Wen Fu to Gongga'erla Mountain.

sentences.zh: 功噶爾拉者兩金川接壤要隘也，峰陡絕，積雪封徑，賊碉扼險。

translations.literal: Gongga'erla was a strategic pass where the two Jinchuan domains met; peaks rose steep and sheer, snow sealed the paths, and bandit blockhouses held the perilous ground.
translations.idiomatic: Gongga'erla was the strategic junction of the two Jinchuan domains—peaks rose sheer, snow blocked the trails, and rebel blockhouses held every pass.

sentences.zh: 額森特督兵直上，副都統烏什哈達繼之，漸克旁碉，戰於固木卜爾山，敗賊。

translations.literal: Esente led troops straight up; Deputy Lieutenant-General Ushihada followed; gradually they took the flanking blockhouses; at Gumubuer Mountain they fought and defeated the bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Esente drove straight up the slope with Deputy Lieutenant-General Ushihada close behind. They cleared the flank blockhouses one by one and routed the enemy at Gumubuer Mountain.

sentences.zh: 從溫福移營木果木，會攻昔嶺，賊碉密布，與海蘭察合攻，冰雪中相持數十日，木果木軍潰。

translations.literal: Following Wen Fu he moved camp to Muguo, joined the attack on Xiling; bandit blockhouses lay thick; together with Hai Lancha he combined the assault; in ice and snow they faced one another for more than ten days; the Muguo army collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: Following Wen Fu to Muguo, he joined the assault on Xiling. With rebel blockhouses everywhere he and Hai Lancha attacked together through ice and snow for more than ten days until the Muguo army was routed.

sentences.zh: 副將軍阿桂在當噶爾拉，全師撤駐翁古爾壟。

translations.literal: Vice-General Agui was at Dangga'erla; the whole army withdrew to camp at Wenguerlong.
translations.idiomatic: Vice-General Agui was at Dangga'erla while the entire army fell back to Wenguerlong.

sentences.zh: 上命阿桂為定邊將軍，再進，額森特與總兵海祿奪北山橋卡。

translations.literal: The Emperor ordered Agui made Pacification General of the Border and to advance again; Esente with Brigade-General Hailu seized North Mountain bridge checkpoints.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor made Agui border pacification general and ordered a fresh advance. Esente and Brigade-General Hailu took the North Mountain bridge checkpoints.

sentences.zh: 總兵成德至，三路合攻阿喀木雅山，乘勝取木蘭壩，平鄂克什官寨。

translations.literal: When Brigade-General Cheng De arrived, three columns jointly attacked Akemuya Mountain, rode victory to take Mulanba, and pacified E'ekeshi official stockade.
translations.idiomatic: When Brigade-General Cheng De arrived the three columns together assaulted Akemuya Mountain, pressed the advantage to take Mulanba, and cleared the E'ekeshi chief stockade.

sentences.zh: 師至路頂宗，額森特越山攀堞躍入，刃賊數十，墮崖死。

translations.literal: When the army reached Ludingzong, Esente climbed over the mountain, scaled the parapet and leaped in, cutting down several dozen bandits who fell from the cliff to their deaths.
translations.idiomatic: At Ludingzong Esente climbed the mountain, scrambled over the parapet and leaped inside, slaying dozens of rebels who toppled from the cliff.

sentences.zh: 進攻明郭宗，遂復美諾，授正紅旗護軍統領，賜御用黑狐冠。

translations.literal: Advancing to attack Mingguozong, he thus recovered Meinuo, was appointed commander of the Plain Red Banner guards, and granted an imperial crown of black fox fur.
translations.idiomatic: Pressing the attack on Mingguozong he recaptured Meinuo, was appointed commander of the Plain Red Banner guards, and granted an imperial crown of black fox fur.

sentences.zh: 偕海蘭察至谷噶山下，有橫梁曰喇穆喇穆，峰勢峻險。

translations.literal: Together with Hai Lancha he reached the foot of Guga Mountain; there was a cross-ridge called Lamulamu, peaks perilously steep.
translations.idiomatic: With Hai Lancha he came to the foot of Guga Mountain, where a cross-ridge called Lamulamu rose in perilously steep peaks.

sentences.zh: 海蘭察與侍衛公保寧從旁進，額森特當其前，夜乘雪影穿箐越險，直前奮擊，轉戰至黎明，已二十餘裡，始見高峰列大碉九，繚石牆。

translations.literal: Hai Lancha with Bodyguard Gong Baoning advanced from the side; Esente faced the front; by night, riding the snow-shadow they passed through gorges and over peril, charged straight forward fiercely fighting, battling until dawn, already more than twenty li, before they saw lofty peaks arrayed with nine great blockhouses ringed by stone walls.
translations.idiomatic: Hai Lancha and Bodyguard Gong Baoning flanked the position while Esente faced the front. Under cover of night and snow they threaded gorges and cliff paths, fought forward until dawn—more than twenty li—and at last saw nine great blockhouses on the heights, ringed by stone walls.

sentences.zh: 俄雪又作，乘晦抵碉趾，賊不敢出，乃攻取其左、右山樑及附近儹巴拉克山峰。

translations.literal: Soon snow fell again; exploiting the darkness they reached the base of the blockhouses; bandits did not dare emerge; they then attacked the left and right ridges and nearby Zanbalake peaks.
translations.idiomatic: Snow returned; in the murk they reached the foot of the blockhouses. The enemy dared not sally out, so they took the left and right ridges and nearby Zanbalake peaks.

sentences.zh: 夜擊梁東色依谷山，與海蘭察兵合。

translations.literal: By night they struck Seyigu Mountain east of the ridge and united with Hai Lancha's troops.
translations.idiomatic: By night they assaulted Seyigu Mountain east of the ridge and linked up with Hai Lancha's force.

sentences.zh: 海蘭察據登古山，與羅博瓦山相對，險特甚。

translations.literal: Hai Lancha held Denggu Mountain, facing Luobowa Mountain; the peril was especially extreme.
translations.idiomatic: Hai Lancha held Denggu Mountain opposite Luobowa Mountain—ground of exceptional peril.

sentences.zh: 共率兵由石罅躍登，林中砲石如雨，及第三峰麓，賊數百分隊迎擊，卒敗之，攻克第二峰碉。

translations.literal: Together they led troops to scramble up through rock clefts; in the forest cannon and stones fell like rain; reaching the foot of the third peak, several hundred bandits in divided squads met them in attack; they finally defeated them and stormed the second peak blockhouse.
translations.idiomatic: They led their men up through rock clefts as cannon and stones rained from the woods. At the third peak hundreds of rebels met them in columns; they beat them back and stormed the blockhouse on the second peak.

sentences.zh: 上獎其奮勉，授散秩大臣。

translations.literal: The Emperor praised their exertions and appointed him minister without portfolio.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised their exertions and appointed Esente minister without portfolio.

sentences.zh: 進剿得斯東寨，斫寨門，縱火，賊出，殺之。

translations.literal: Advancing to suppress Desidong stockade, he chopped the gate, set fire; bandits emerged and he killed them.
translations.idiomatic: He pressed Desidong stockade, broke the gate, and set it ablaze. When the enemy poured out he cut them down.

sentences.zh: 雪夜，賊劫副將常祿保營，額森特聞槍聲赴援，賊敗走。

translations.literal: On a snowy night bandits raided Brigade-General Chang Lubao's camp; Esente heard the gunfire and rushed to aid; bandits were defeated and fled.
translations.idiomatic: On a snowy night rebels raided Brigade-General Chang Lubao's camp. Hearing the gunfire Esente rushed to the rescue and drove them off.

sentences.zh: 賊乘雨霧建二碉於羅博瓦山，額森特與海蘭察率兵八百，夜雨中薄碉，毀牆入，賊驚竄，平其碉。

translations.literal: Bandits took advantage of rain and fog to build two blockhouses on Luobowa Mountain; Esente with Hai Lancha led eight hundred troops, in night rain pressed close to the blockhouses, broke the wall and entered; bandits fled in alarm; the blockhouses were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: In rain and fog the enemy threw up two blockhouses on Luobowa Mountain. Esente and Hai Lancha led eight hundred men through the night rain, broke through the walls, and cleared the position.

sentences.zh: 賊夜劫烏什哈達營，追擊敗之。

translations.literal: Bandits raided Ushihada's camp by night; he pursued, struck, and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: When rebels raided Ushihada's camp by night he pursued and routed them.

sentences.zh: 賊於羅博瓦峰下色淜普大岡置大碉六，左右相應援。

translations.literal: Bandits set six great blockhouses on Seqinpu Great Ridge below Luobowa Peak, left and right mutually reinforcing one another.
translations.idiomatic: Below Luobowa Peak the enemy built six large blockhouses on Seqinpu Great Ridge, mutually supporting one another.

sentences.zh: 海蘭察克其中三碉，額森特克其左二，烏什哈達克其右一，山砦皆平，上嘉之，制詩紀事。

translations.literal: Hai Lancha took three of them in the center; Esente took two on the left; Ushihada took one on the right; all mountain strongpoints were pacified; the Emperor praised this and composed an imperial poem to record the event.
translations.idiomatic: Hai Lancha took the three center blockhouses, Esente the two on the left, and Ushihada the one on the right. With every strongpoint cleared the emperor commended them and composed an imperial poem to record the feat.

sentences.zh: 額森特於大雨中攻色淜普左偏，砍柵進，克二木城，遙見該布達什諾各砦煙起，知海蘭察兵至，遂乘機奪筆郎納克、該筆達烏諸砦，改墨爾根巴圖魯，賜白金二百。

translations.literal: Esente in heavy rain attacked the left flank of Seqinpu, cut through the palisade and advanced, took two wooden forts; from afar saw smoke rising from Gaibudashinuo stockades and knew Hai Lancha's troops had arrived; he then seized the opportunity to take Bilangnake, Gaibidawu, and other stockades; his baturu title was changed to Moergen Baturu and he was granted two hundred taels of white silver.
translations.idiomatic: In pouring rain Esente assaulted the left of Seqinpu, broke through the palisade and took two wooden forts. Seeing smoke rise from Gaibudashinuo he knew Hai Lancha had arrived and seized Bilangnake, Gaibidawu, and the other stockades. His baturu title was changed to Moergen Baturu and he received two hundred taels of silver.

sentences.zh: 師圍遜克爾宗，額森特與海蘭察毀平房、碉卡二百餘。

translations.literal: When the army besieged Xunke'erzong, Esente with Hai Lancha destroyed more than two hundred houses, blockhouses, and checkpoints.
translations.idiomatic: During the siege of Xunke'erzong, Esente and Hai Lancha destroyed more than two hundred dwellings, blockhouses, and checkpoints.

sentences.zh: 克水碉，攻官寨，自叢木中驟逼寨牆，賊死戰，額森特傷鼻及足；

translations.literal: He took the water blockhouse and attacked the official stockade; from among thick trees he suddenly pressed close to the stockade wall; bandits fought to the death; Esente was wounded in the nose and foot.
translations.idiomatic: He stormed the water blockhouse and then the chief stockade, bursting from the undergrowth to the wall. The enemy fought to the death; Esente was wounded in the nose and foot.

sentences.zh: 撲第三寨，賊舉槍折其弓弰，傷指，易弓，連斃數賊。

translations.literal: Assaulting the third stockade, bandits raised muskets and broke his bowstring; he was wounded in the finger; he changed bows and in succession shot down several bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Assaulting the third stockade the enemy musketry broke his bowstring and wounded his finger. He took another bow and shot down several rebels in succession.

sentences.zh: 上以額森特被傷能易弓射賊，手詔嘉獎，賜貂冠、猞猁猻褂。

translations.literal: Because Esente wounded yet could change bows and shoot bandits, the Emperor sent a personally written edict of praise and granted a sable crown and lynx-fur jacket.
translations.idiomatic: Impressed that Esente could switch bows and keep shooting despite his wounds, the emperor sent a personal edict of praise and granted him a sable crown and lynx-fur jacket.

sentences.zh: 攻默格爾山，與海蘭察共攻克密拉噶拉木碉及凱立葉官寨。

translations.literal: Attacking Mogeer Mountain, together with Hai Lancha he jointly stormed Milagalamu blockhouse and Kailiye official stockade.
translations.idiomatic: At Mogeer Mountain he and Hai Lancha together stormed the Milagalamu blockhouse and the Kailiye chief stockade.

sentences.zh: 敗勒烏圍援賊，馘百餘，授參贊大臣。

translations.literal: He defeated Lewuwei relief bandits, took more than a hundred heads, and was appointed participating minister.
translations.idiomatic: He routed the Lewuwei relief force, took more than a hundred heads, and was appointed participating minister.

sentences.zh: 乘勝取布拉克森及格斯巴爾二山，毀山下羅卜克鄂博溝口七碉，於是凱立葉上下及附近寨落皆平。

translations.literal: Riding victory he took Bolakesen and Gesiba'er two mountains, destroyed seven blockhouses at the Luoboke'aobo ravine mouth below the mountains; thus above and below Kailiye and nearby stockade settlements were all pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Pressing the advantage he took Bolakesen and Gesiba'er Mountains, destroyed seven blockhouses at the Luoboke'aobo gorge, and cleared every settlement around Kailiye.

sentences.zh: 上獎其奮勉超群，命在乾清門行走。

translations.literal: The Emperor praised his exertions as surpassing others and ordered him to serve at the Gate of Heavenly Purity.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised his prowess above the rest and ordered him to serve at the Gate of Heavenly Purity.

sentences.zh: 復與海蘭察分隊乘月黑度山溝，入格普古丫口，得碉卡十二。

translations.literal: Again with Hai Lancha he divided teams, on a moonless night crossed a mountain ravine, entered Gepugu Yakou, and obtained twelve blockhouses and checkpoints.
translations.idiomatic: Again with Hai Lancha he split into columns, crossed a ravine on a moonless night, entered Gepugu Yakou, and captured twelve blockhouses and checkpoints.

sentences.zh: 抵桑噶斯瑪特，破石城、木柵，奪擦庸、群尼二寨。

translations.literal: Reaching Sangasimate, he broke stone forts and wooden palisades, seizing Cayong and Qunni two stockades.
translations.idiomatic: At Sangasimate he broke stone forts and wooden palisades and took the Cayong and Qunni stockades.

sentences.zh: 攻上下巴木通，克之。

translations.literal: Attacking upper and lower Bamutong, he took them.
translations.idiomatic: He assaulted upper and lower Bamutong and carried both.

sentences.zh: 下寨落百餘，賊不敢复拒。

translations.literal: More than a hundred lower stockade settlements—bandits dared not resist again.
translations.idiomatic: More than a hundred settlements below fell, and the rebels dared not resist further.

sentences.zh: 至直古腦山頂，與福康安兵合，直趨勒烏圍賊巢。

translations.literal: Reaching Zhigunao mountain summit, he united with Fukang'an's troops and pressed straight toward the Lewuwei bandit lair.
translations.idiomatic: On the summit of Zhigunao he joined Fukang'an's column and drove straight at the Lewuwei rebel stronghold.

sentences.zh: 賊負高阻深，力戰克之。

translations.literal: Bandits held the heights and blocked the depths, but through fierce fighting they were taken.
translations.idiomatic: The enemy held the heights and deep defenses but were taken after hard fighting.

sentences.zh: 額森特負傷不能乘馬，上命駐守勒烏圍。

translations.literal: Esente was wounded and unable to ride; the Emperor ordered him to garrison Lewuwei.
translations.idiomatic: Esente was too badly wounded to ride, and the emperor ordered him to garrison Lewuwei.

sentences.zh: 額森特隔河見明亮兵攻阿爾古，發砲助之。

translations.literal: Esente across the river saw Mingliang's troops attacking A'ergu and fired cannon to assist.
translations.idiomatic: From across the river Esente saw Mingliang's force attacking A'ergu and brought up artillery to support him.

sentences.zh: 上聞，曰：「額森特不分畛域，無愧為參贊！」

translations.literal: The Emperor hearing this said: "Esente does not distinguish boundaries—worthy to be called participating minister!"
translations.idiomatic: Hearing of it the emperor said: "Esente shows no petty boundary—he is truly a participating minister!"

sentences.zh: 額森特望見攻西里官兵得捷，率保寧、常祿保等攻西里山麓，克其木城。

translations.literal: Esente seeing the troops attacking Xili achieve victory, led Baoning, Chang Lubao, and others to attack the foot of Xili Mountain and took its wooden fort.
translations.idiomatic: Seeing the assault on Xili succeed, Esente led Baoning, Chang Lubao, and others against the lower slopes of Xili Mountain and took its wooden fort.

sentences.zh: 勒烏圍前山曰克爾古什拉斯者，取噶拉依正道也。

translations.literal: Before Lewuwei, the forward mountain called Kerugushilasi was the direct route to take Gelayi.
translations.idiomatic: Before Lewuwei the forward slope called Kerugushilasi was the main route to Gelayi.

sentences.zh: 賊於山上城碉密布，額森特攻克之。

translations.literal: Bandits had blockhouses and forts densely arrayed on the mountain; Esente stormed and took them.
translations.idiomatic: The enemy had blockhouses and forts thick on the heights; Esente stormed them and carried the position.

sentences.zh: 乘勝取格隆古。

translations.literal: Riding victory he took Gelonggu.
translations.idiomatic: Pressing the advantage he took Gelonggu.

sentences.zh: 師將逼賊巢，賊恃布哈爾、則朗噶克為門戶，斫木塞道。

translations.literal: The army was about to press the bandit lair; bandits relied on Buha'er and Zelangga'ke as their gateway and felled trees to block the road.
translations.idiomatic: As the army closed on the rebel stronghold the enemy held Buha'er and Zelangga'ke as their gateway and felled trees to block the path.

sentences.zh: 額森特率諸將烏爾納、那木扎、彰靄等進攻，賊伏積木中，發槍如雨。

translations.literal: Esente led the generals Wul'ena, Namuzha, Zhang'ai, and others in the advance; bandits lay hidden in piled timber and fired muskets like rain.
translations.idiomatic: Esente led Wul'ena, Namuzha, Zhang'ai, and the other officers forward. The enemy lay hidden in timber stacks and opened fire like rain.

sentences.zh: 額森特乘柵以登，設伏兵夾擊，賊遂驚潰。

translations.literal: Esente climbed the palisade to ascend, set ambush troops for a pincer strike, and the bandits broke in alarm and rout.
translations.idiomatic: Esente scaled the palisade, laid ambushes for a pincer attack, and the rebels broke and fled in panic.

sentences.zh: 進克喀爾巴山後，毀附近寨落，遂薄噶拉依。

translations.literal: Advancing he took the rear of Ka'erba Mountain, destroyed nearby stockade settlements, and thus pressed close to Gelayi.
translations.idiomatic: He advanced to the rear of Ka'erba Mountain, destroyed the neighboring settlements, and closed on Gelayi.

sentences.zh: 上嘉額森特勇，封一等嫺勇男，世襲。

translations.literal: The Emperor praised Esente's bravery and enfeoffed him as first-class Baron of Xianyong, with hereditary succession.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised Esente's valor and enfeoffed him as first-class Baron of Xianyong, inheritable in perpetuity.

sentences.zh: 金川平，賜御用鞍馬、緞二十端、白金千。

translations.literal: When Jinchuan was pacified, granted an imperial saddle and horse, twenty bolts of silk, and one thousand taels of white silver.
translations.idiomatic: With Jinchuan pacified he received an imperial saddle and horse, twenty bolts of silk, and one thousand taels of silver.

sentences.zh: 圖形紫光閣，列前五十功臣。

translations.literal: His portrait was placed in the Hall of Purple Splendor among the first fifty meritorious ministers.
translations.idiomatic: His portrait was placed in the Hall of Purple Splendor among the fifty foremost meritorious ministers.

sentences.zh: 四十六年，循化回蘇四十三因爭立新教為亂，破河州，命從大學士阿桂討之，額森特與海蘭察、明亮等分攻華林山，力戰被傷。

translations.literal: In the forty-sixth year, the Xunhua Muslim Su Sishi raised rebellion over a dispute over the new teaching, broke Hezhou, and was ordered to follow Grand Secretary Agui in the punitive campaign; Esente with Hai Lancha, Mingliang, and others separately attacked Hualin Mountain and was wounded in fierce fighting.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-sixth year the Xunhua Muslim Su Sishi rebelled over a dispute about the new teaching and overran Hezhou. Ordered to follow Grand Secretary Agui, Esente joined Hai Lancha, Mingliang, and others in assaulting Hualin Mountain and was wounded in fierce fighting.

sentences.zh: 賊平，進三等子。

translations.literal: When the bandits were pacified, he was advanced to third-class viscount.
translations.idiomatic: When the rebellion was suppressed he was raised to third-class viscount.

sentences.zh: 四十七年，卒。

translations.literal: In the forty-seventh year, he died.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-seventh year he died.

sentences.zh: 普爾普，額爾特肯氏，蒙古正黃旗人。

translations.literal: Pu'erpu, of the Erteken clan, a Mongol of the Plain Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Pu'erpu, of the Erteken clan, was a Mongol of the Plain Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 父巴圖濟爾噶爾，本額魯特杜爾伯特部宰桑。

translations.literal: His father Batujiergaer was originally a zaisang of the Olot Dorbod tribe.
translations.idiomatic: His father Batujiergaer had been a zaisang of the Olot Dorbod tribe.

sentences.zh: 來降，隸蒙古正黃旗。

translations.literal: He came to submit and was enrolled in the Mongol Plain Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: He submitted and was enrolled in the Mongol Plain Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 從征準噶爾，討霍集占，皆有功。

translations.literal: Following campaigns against the Dzungars and against Hu Jizhan, he had merit in both.
translations.idiomatic: He served in the campaigns against the Dzungars and against Hu Jizhan and won distinction in both.

sentences.zh: 官至內大臣，賜騎都尉世職，圖形紫光閣。

translations.literal: He rose to inner court minister, was granted a hereditary commandant of cavalry post, and his portrait was placed in the Hall of Purple Splendor.
translations.idiomatic: He rose to inner court minister, received a hereditary commandant of cavalry rank, and had his portrait placed in the Hall of Purple Splendor.

sentences.zh: 普爾普自閒散再遷三等侍衛。

translations.literal: Pu'erpu, from idle status, was again promoted to third-class bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: From unattached status, Pu'erpu was again promoted to third-class bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 從征緬甸，擢御前侍衛，授公中佐領。

translations.literal: He followed the Burma campaign, was promoted to imperial bodyguard before the throne, and appointed company commander of the imperial guard.
translations.idiomatic: He joined the Burma campaign, was raised to imperial bodyguard before the throne, and given the post of company commander in the imperial guard.

sentences.zh: 乾隆三十七年，命率額魯特兵詣金川，從定邊右將軍溫福進討。

translations.literal: In the thirty-seventh year of the Qianlong reign, he was ordered to lead Olot troops to Jinchuan and follow the Right Pacification General Wen Fu in the punitive advance.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-seventh year of Qianlong he was ordered to lead Olot troops to Jinchuan and join Right Pacification General Wen Fu in the punitive campaign.

sentences.zh: 師攻達克蘇，普爾普奪賊卡，斷賊來路。

translations.literal: When the army attacked Dakusu, Pu'erpu seized rebel checkpoints and cut off the rebel line of approach.
translations.idiomatic: When the army assaulted Dakusu, Pu'erpu stormed the rebel checkpoints and severed their line of approach.

sentences.zh: 從參贊大臣豐升額攻明郭宗，命為領隊侍衛，偕巴雅爾取明郭宗南寨，加副都統銜。

translations.literal: Following Participating Minister Feng Sheng'e in the attack on Mingguozong, he was appointed leading bodyguard; together with Bayar he took the southern stockade of Mingguozong, and was given the rank of deputy lieutenant-general.
translations.idiomatic: Following Participating Minister Feng Sheng'e against Mingguozong, he was made leading bodyguard and, with Bayar, seized its southern stockade. He was given the rank of deputy lieutenant-general.

sentences.zh: 進攻噶爾拉，經丫口，盡得賊卡寨。

translations.literal: Advancing against Ga'era, he passed through Yakou and took all the rebel checkpoints and stockades.
translations.idiomatic: Pressing the attack on Ga'era, he passed Yakou and captured every rebel checkpoint and stockade.

sentences.zh: 偕副都統海蘭察攻昔嶺，克要路碉二。

translations.literal: Together with Deputy Lieutenant-General Hai Lancha he attacked Xiling and captured two blockhouses on vital routes.
translations.idiomatic: Together with Deputy Lieutenant-General Hai Lancha he assaulted Xiling and took two blockhouses commanding the key passes.

sentences.zh: 普爾普與海蘭察、額

translations.literal: Pu'erpu, together with Hai Lancha, Esente, Bayar, Ushihada, Ma Quan, and Aernasu fought with exceptional force.
translations.idiomatic: Pu'erpu fought alongside Hai Lancha, Esente, Bayar, Ushihada, Ma Quan, and Arnasu with exceptional fierceness.

sentences.zh: 前山曰克爾古什拉斯者，取噶拉依正道也。

translations.literal: The forward mountain called Kerugushilasi was the direct route to take Gelayi.
translations.idiomatic: The forward slope called Kerugushilasi was the main route to Gelayi.

sentences.zh: 賊於山上城碉密布，額森特攻克之。

translations.literal: Bandits had blockhouses and forts densely arrayed on the mountain; Esente stormed and took them.
translations.idiomatic: The enemy had blockhouses and forts thick on the heights; Esente stormed them and carried the position.

sentences.zh: 乘勝取格隆古。

translations.literal: Riding victory he took Gelonggu.
translations.idiomatic: Pressing the advantage he took Gelonggu.

sentences.zh: 師將逼賊巢，賊恃布哈爾、則朗噶克為門戶，斫木塞道。

translations.literal: The army was about to press the bandit lair; bandits relied on Buha'er and Zelangga'ke as their gateway and felled trees to block the road.
translations.idiomatic: As the army closed on the rebel stronghold the enemy held Buha'er and Zelangga'ke as their gateway and felled trees to block the path.

sentences.zh: 額森特率諸將烏爾納、那木扎、彰靄等進攻，賊伏積木中，發槍如雨。

translations.literal: Esente led the generals Wul'ena, Namuzha, Zhang'ai, and others in the advance; bandits lay hidden in piled timber and fired muskets like rain.
translations.idiomatic: Esente led Wul'ena, Namuzha, Zhang'ai, and the other officers forward. The enemy lay hidden in timber stacks and opened fire like rain.

sentences.zh: 額森特乘柵以登，設伏兵夾擊，賊遂驚潰。

translations.literal: Esente climbed the palisade to ascend, set ambush troops for a pincer strike, and the bandits broke in alarm and rout.
translations.idiomatic: Esente scaled the palisade, laid ambushes for a pincer attack, and the rebels broke and fled in panic.

sentences.zh: 進克喀爾巴山後，毀附近寨落，遂薄噶拉依。

translations.literal: Advancing he took the rear of Ka'erba Mountain, destroyed nearby stockade settlements, and thus pressed close to Gelayi.
translations.idiomatic: He advanced to the rear of Ka'erba Mountain, destroyed the neighboring settlements, and closed on Gelayi.

sentences.zh: 上嘉額森特勇，封一等嫺勇男，世襲。

translations.literal: The Emperor praised Esente's bravery and enfeoffed him as first-class Baron of Xianyong, with hereditary succession.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised Esente's valor and enfeoffed him as first-class Baron of Xianyong, inheritable in perpetuity.

sentences.zh: 金川平，賜御用鞍馬、緞二十端、白金千。

translations.literal: When Jinchuan was pacified, granted an imperial saddle and horse, twenty bolts of silk, and one thousand taels of white silver.
translations.idiomatic: With Jinchuan pacified he received an imperial saddle and horse, twenty bolts of silk, and one thousand taels of silver.

sentences.zh: 圖形紫光閣，列前五十功臣。

translations.literal: His portrait was placed in the Hall of Purple Splendor among the first fifty meritorious ministers.
translations.idiomatic: His portrait was placed in the Hall of Purple Splendor among the fifty foremost meritorious ministers.

sentences.zh: 四十六年，循化回蘇四十三因爭立新教為亂，破河州，命從大學士阿桂討之，額森特與海蘭察、明亮等分攻華林山，力戰被傷。

translations.literal: In the forty-sixth year, the Xunhua Muslim Su Sishi raised rebellion over a dispute over the new teaching, broke Hezhou, and was ordered to follow Grand Secretary Agui in the punitive campaign; Esente with Hai Lancha, Mingliang, and others separately attacked Hualin Mountain and was wounded in fierce fighting.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-sixth year the Xunhua Muslim Su Sishi rebelled over a dispute about the new teaching and overran Hezhou. Ordered to follow Grand Secretary Agui, Esente joined Hai Lancha, Mingliang, and others in assaulting Hualin Mountain and was wounded in fierce fighting.

sentences.zh: 賊平，進三等子。

translations.literal: When the bandits were pacified, he was advanced to third-class viscount.
translations.idiomatic: When the rebellion was suppressed he was raised to third-class viscount.

sentences.zh: 四十七年，卒。

translations.literal: In the forty-seventh year, he died.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-seventh year he died.

sentences.zh: 普爾普，額爾特肯氏，蒙古正黃旗人。

translations.literal: Pu'erpu, of the Erteken clan, a Mongol of the Plain Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Pu'erpu, of the Erteken clan, was a Mongol of the Plain Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 父巴圖濟爾噶爾，本額魯特杜爾伯特部宰桑。

translations.literal: His father Batujiergaer was originally a zaisang of the Olot Dorbod tribe.
translations.idiomatic: His father Batujiergaer had been a zaisang of the Olot Dorbod tribe.

sentences.zh: 來降，隸蒙古正黃旗。

translations.literal: He came to submit and was enrolled in the Mongol Plain Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: He submitted and was enrolled in the Mongol Plain Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 從征準噶爾，討霍集占，皆有功。

translations.literal: Following campaigns against the Dzungars and against Hu Jizhan, he had merit in both.
translations.idiomatic: He served in the campaigns against the Dzungars and against Hu Jizhan and won distinction in both.

sentences.zh: 官至內大臣，賜騎都尉世職，圖形紫光閣。

translations.literal: He rose to inner court minister, was granted a hereditary commandant of cavalry post, and his portrait was placed in the Hall of Purple Splendor.
translations.idiomatic: He rose to inner court minister, received a hereditary commandant of cavalry rank, and had his portrait placed in the Hall of Purple Splendor.

sentences.zh: 普爾普自閒散再遷三等侍衛。

translations.literal: Pu'erpu, from idle status, was again promoted to third-class bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: From unattached status, Pu'erpu was again promoted to third-class bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 從征緬甸，擢御前侍衛，授公中佐領。

translations.literal: He followed the Burma campaign, was promoted to imperial bodyguard before the throne, and appointed company commander of the imperial guard.
translations.idiomatic: He joined the Burma campaign, was raised to imperial bodyguard before the throne, and given the post of company commander in the imperial guard.

sentences.zh: 乾隆三十七年，命率額魯特兵詣金川，從定邊右將軍溫福進討。

translations.literal: In the thirty-seventh year of the Qianlong reign, he was ordered to lead Olot troops to Jinchuan and follow the Right Pacification General Wen Fu in the punitive advance.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-seventh year of Qianlong he was ordered to lead Olot troops to Jinchuan and join Right Pacification General Wen Fu in the punitive campaign.

sentences.zh: 師攻達克蘇，普爾普奪賊卡，斷賊來路。

translations.literal: When the army attacked Dakusu, Pu'erpu seized rebel checkpoints and cut off the rebel line of approach.
translations.idiomatic: When the army assaulted Dakusu, Pu'erpu stormed the rebel checkpoints and severed their line of approach.

sentences.zh: 從參贊大臣豐升額攻明郭宗，命為領隊侍衛，偕巴雅爾取明郭宗南寨，加副都統銜。

translations.literal: Following Participating Minister Feng Sheng'e in the attack on Mingguozong, he was appointed leading bodyguard; together with Bayar he took the southern stockade of Mingguozong, and was given the rank of deputy lieutenant-general.
translations.idiomatic: Following Participating Minister Feng Sheng'e against Mingguozong, he was made leading bodyguard and, with Bayar, seized its southern stockade. He was given the rank of deputy lieutenant-general.

sentences.zh: 進攻噶爾拉，經丫口，盡得賊卡寨。

translations.literal: Advancing against Ga'era, he passed through Yakou and took all the rebel checkpoints and stockades.
translations.idiomatic: Pressing the attack on Ga'era, he passed Yakou and captured every rebel checkpoint and stockade.

sentences.zh: 偕副都統海蘭察攻昔嶺，克要路碉二。

translations.literal: Together with Deputy Lieutenant-General Hai Lancha he attacked Xiling and captured two blockhouses on vital routes.
translations.idiomatic: Together with Deputy Lieutenant-General Hai Lancha he assaulted Xiling and took two blockhouses commanding the key passes.

sentences.zh: 普爾普與海蘭察、額森特、巴雅爾、烏什哈達、馬全、阿爾納素戰尤力。

translations.literal: Pu'erpu fought with exceptional force together with Hai Lancha, Esente, Bayar, Ushihada, Ma Quan, and Arnasu.
translations.idiomatic: Pu'erpu fought with exceptional fierceness alongside Hai Lancha, Esente, Bayar, Ushihada, Ma Quan, and Arnasu.

sentences.zh: 復與諸將攻斯達克拉、阿噶爾布里、碩藏噶爾山梁，克之。

translations.literal: Again with the other generals he attacked the ridges at Sidakela, Aga'erburi, and Shuocangga'er and took them.
translations.idiomatic: He again joined the other generals in assaulting the ridges at Sidakela, Aga'erburi, and Shuocangga'er, and all fell.

sentences.zh: 進攻色布色爾山梁，得賊碉十餘。

translations.literal: Advancing against the Sebuse'er ridge, he captured more than ten rebel blockhouses.
translations.idiomatic: Pressing against the Sebuse'er ridge, he took more than ten rebel blockhouses.

sentences.zh: 羅博瓦者，金川渠所恃為門戶者也，師進，悉據其諸峰，授散秩大臣。

translations.literal: Luobowa was what the Jinchuan chiefs relied upon as their gateway; as the army advanced, they seized all its peaks, and he was appointed minister without portfolio.
translations.idiomatic: Luobowa was the gateway the Jinchuan chiefs had relied upon. As the army advanced, they seized all its peaks, and Pu'erpu was appointed minister without portfolio.

sentences.zh: 賊劫副將常祿保，援擊敗之。

translations.literal: When bandits raided Brigade-General Chang Lubao, he went to the rescue and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: When rebels raided Brigade-General Chang Lubao, he rushed to his aid and drove them off.

sentences.zh: 與海蘭察合攻喇穆喇穆，射殺紅衣賊渠。

translations.literal: Together with Hai Lancha he jointly attacked Lamulamu and shot dead a rebel chieftain in red robes.
translations.idiomatic: Joining Hai Lancha, he assaulted Lamulamu and shot dead a rebel chieftain clad in red.

sentences.zh: 又拔該布達什諾木城二，賜御用黑狐冠。

translations.literal: He also stormed two stockades at Gaibudashinuo and was granted an imperial crown of black fox fur.
translations.idiomatic: He also took two stockades at Gaibudashinuo and was granted an imperial crown of black fox fur.

sentences.zh: 賊劫我軍所置卡，與烏什哈達赴援，賊潰。

translations.literal: When bandits raided a checkpoint set up by our army, he rushed to assist with Ushihada, and the bandits broke.
translations.idiomatic: When rebels raided a checkpoint our army had established, he hurried to the rescue with Ushihada and the enemy broke and fled.

sentences.zh: 攻遜克爾宗，中創，復攻舍圖旺，斷遜克爾宗去路。

translations.literal: Attacking Xunke'erzong, he was wounded; he then attacked Shetuwang and cut off the escape route from Xunke'erzong.
translations.idiomatic: In the assault on Xunke'erzong he was wounded. He then attacked Shetuwang and cut off the route of retreat from Xunke'erzong.

sentences.zh: 偕台斐英阿等攻章噶，得賊寨二十餘。

translations.literal: Together with Taifeiying'a and others he attacked Zhangga and took more than twenty rebel stockades.
translations.idiomatic: With Taifeiying'a and others he assaulted Zhangga and captured more than twenty rebel stockades.

sentences.zh: 又克隆斯得寨，賊貯鉛丸火藥處也，遂偕台斐英阿等克勒烏圍，賜什勒瑪咳巴圖魯名號。

translations.literal: He also stormed the Kesiude stockade, where the bandits stored lead shot and gunpowder; then, together with Taifeiying'a and others, he captured Lewuwei and was granted the baturu title Shilemaike Baturu.
translations.idiomatic: He also stormed Kesiude, where the rebels stored lead shot and gunpowder, then joined Taifeiying'a and others in capturing Lewuwei. For this he was granted the baturu title Shilemaike Baturu.

sentences.zh: 進攻阿穰曲強達巴，克大碉三、木城四。

translations.literal: Advancing against Arangquqiangdaba, he took three large blockhouses and four wooden fortresses.
translations.idiomatic: Pressing the attack on Arangquqiangdaba, he captured three large blockhouses and four wooden fortresses.

sentences.zh: 仰攻西里山峰，賊越碉竄，普爾普逐捕，所殺傷過當。

translations.literal: Attacking uphill at Xili mountain peak, the bandits fled over the blockhouses; Pu'erpu pursued and captured them, and the killed and wounded far exceeded proportion.
translations.idiomatic: Assaulting the Xili peak from below, he pursued rebels fleeing over the blockhouses and killed or wounded far more than his own losses.

sentences.zh: 攻舍勒圖租魯，得碉一；

translations.literal: Attacking Sheletuzulu, he took one blockhouse;
translations.idiomatic: At Sheletuzulu he captured one blockhouse;

sentences.zh: 攻開布智章，得寨一。

translations.literal: Attacking Kaibuzhizhang, he took one stockade.
translations.idiomatic: at Kaibuzhizhang he took one stockade.

sentences.zh: 又克薩爾歪，阿結佔賊寨，據勒隈勒木通、科布曲山梁，斬獲甚眾。

translations.literal: He also took Sa'erwai and Aji'zhan rebel stockades, held the ridges at Leiweilemutong and Kebuqu, and killed and captured in great numbers.
translations.idiomatic: He also stormed the rebel stockades at Sa'erwai and Aji'zhan, held the ridges at Leiweilemutong and Kebuqu, and killed and captured in great numbers.

sentences.zh: 四十一年正月，合諸軍圍噶拉依，普爾普出其右，與海蘭察築壘逼賊巢，遂克之。

translations.literal: In the first month of the forty-first year, uniting all armies to besiege Gelayi, Pu'erpu came out on the right; with Hai Lancha he built fortifications pressing the rebel lair, and took it.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the forty-first year the combined armies besieged Gelayi. Pu'erpu took the right flank and, with Hai Lancha, built fortifications pressing the rebel stronghold until it fell.

sentences.zh: 金川平，封三等奮勇男，世襲。

translations.literal: When Jinchuan was pacified, he was enfeoffed as third-class Baron of Fenyong, with hereditary succession.
translations.idiomatic: With Jinchuan pacified, he was enfeoffed as third-class Baron of Fenyong, inheritable in perpetuity.

sentences.zh: 圖形紫光閣，列前五十功臣。

translations.literal: His portrait was placed in the Hall of Purple Splendor among the first fifty meritorious ministers.
translations.idiomatic: His portrait was placed in the Hall of Purple Splendor among the fifty foremost meritorious ministers.

sentences.zh: 師還，上郊勞，賜御用鞍轡馬一。

translations.literal: When the army returned, the Emperor welcomed him outside the capital and bestowed one imperial saddle, bridle, and horse.
translations.idiomatic: On the army's return the emperor welcomed him outside the capital and gave him an imperial saddle, bridle, and horse.

sentences.zh: 授正紅旗護軍統領，正白旗滿洲副都統，賜雙眼花翎。

translations.literal: Appointed commander of the Plain Red Banner guards, Manchu deputy lieutenant-general of the Plain White Banner, and granted the double-eyed peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed commander of the Plain Red Banner guards and Manchu deputy lieutenant-general of the Plain White Banner, and granted the double-eyed peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 四十三年，扈蹕謁泰東陵。

translations.literal: In the forty-third year, he accompanied the imperial procession to pay homage at the Eastern Tombs.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-third year he accompanied the imperial procession to pay homage at the Eastern Tombs.

sentences.zh: 離營住宿，坐奪雙眼花翎。

translations.literal: For leaving camp to lodge elsewhere, he was stripped of the double-eyed peacock feather by formal judgment.
translations.idiomatic: For leaving camp to lodge elsewhere, he was formally stripped of his double-eyed peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 林爽文之亂，授領隊大臣，命從將軍福康安赴台灣援嘉義，解圍，克大里杙。

translations.literal: During the Lin Shuangwen rebellion, he was appointed leading minister and ordered to follow General Fukang'an to Taiwan to relieve Jiayi, lift the siege, and take Daliyi.
translations.idiomatic: During the Lin Shuangwen rebellion he was made leading minister and ordered to follow General Fukang'an to Taiwan, relieve Jiayi, lift the siege, and storm Daliyi.

sentences.zh: 爽文逃小半天山頂，同海蘭察進攻，賊拒戰，山路險惡，普爾普率廣東兵及屯練降番攀木柵先登，賊潰，遂擒爽文。

translations.literal: Shuangwen fled to the summit of Xiaobantian Mountain; together with Hai Lancha he advanced the attack. The bandits resisted; the mountain paths were treacherous. Pu'erpu led Guangdong troops and surrendered aboriginal auxiliaries to scale the wooden palisades first; the bandits broke, and Shuangwen was captured.
translations.idiomatic: Shuangwen fled to the summit of Xiaobantian Mountain. Pu'erpu and Hai Lancha pressed the attack, but the rebels held firm and the mountain paths were treacherous. Pu'erpu led Guangdong troops and surrendered aboriginal auxiliaries up the wooden palisades first. The rebels broke, and Shuangwen was captured.

sentences.zh: 進軍瑯嶠，追勦賊目莊大田，賊來劫營，普爾普於大武壟隘口衝殺，敗之。

translations.literal: Advancing to Langqiao to pursue and suppress the rebel chieftain Zhuang Datian, when bandits came to raid the camp Pu'erpu charged at Dafulong Pass and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: Advancing to Langqiao to pursue and suppress the rebel chieftain Zhuang Datian, he met a rebel raid on the camp at Dafulong Pass, charged, and drove them off.

sentences.zh: 諭於台灣嘉義建生祠。

translations.literal: An edict ordered a living shrine built for him at Jiayi in Taiwan.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered a living shrine erected to him at Jiayi in Taiwan.

sentences.zh: 事見福康安傳。

translations.literal: The affair is recorded in Fukang'an's biography.
translations.idiomatic: The affair is recorded in Fukang'an's biography.

sentences.zh: 大田就擒，台灣平，再圖形紫光閣，晉封二等男，襲一次，以三等男世襲。

translations.literal: When Datian was captured and Taiwan pacified, his portrait was again placed in the Hall of Purple Splendor. He was raised to second-class baron, inheritable once, with third-class baron thereafter hereditary.
translations.idiomatic: When Datian was captured and Taiwan pacified, his portrait was again placed in the Hall of Purple Splendor. He was raised to second-class baron, inheritable for one generation, with third-class baron thereafter hereditary.

sentences.zh: 五十五年，卒。

translations.literal: In the fifty-fifth year, he died.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-fifth year he died.

sentences.zh: 論曰：海蘭察勇而有智略。

translations.literal: The commentary says: Hai Lancha was brave and possessed strategic wisdom.
translations.idiomatic: The commentary says: Hai Lancha was brave and possessed strategic wisdom.

sentences.zh: 每戰，微服策馬觀敵，察其瑕，集兵攻之，輒勝。

translations.literal: Before each battle, he would don plain clothes, ride out to observe the enemy, spy out their weaknesses, then concentrate troops to strike—and always won.
translations.idiomatic: Before each battle he would don plain clothes, ride out to observe the enemy, find their weaknesses, and concentrate his troops for the strike—and always won.

sentences.zh: 平生惟服阿桂知兵，福康安禮先焉，乃為盡力，師所向有功。

translations.literal: In life he acknowledged only Agui's mastery of war; when Fukang'an treated him with precedence, he gave his utmost, and wherever the army went he achieved merit.
translations.idiomatic: In life he acknowledged only Agui's mastery of war. When Fukang'an treated him with precedence, he gave his utmost, and wherever the army marched he won distinction.

sentences.zh: 奎林亦孝賢皇后諸侄，剛而不撓，勳名與群從並。

translations.literal: Kuilin too was among the Empress Xiaoxian's nephews—unyielding and resolute, his fame for merit ranked with his kinsmen.
translations.idiomatic: Kuilin too was among Empress Xiaoxian's nephews—unyielding and resolute, his fame for merit standing with his kinsmen.

sentences.zh: 和隆武、額森特、普爾普皆以克敵功最受封爵。

translations.literal: Helongwu, Esente, and Pu'erpu all received the highest ennoblements for their achievements in defeating the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: Helongwu, Esente, and Pu'erpu all won the highest ennoblements for their feats in defeating the enemy.

sentences.zh: 乾隆中多將材，此尤其魁傑也。

translations.literal: In the Qianlong era there were many capable generals; these were especially outstanding among them.
translations.idiomatic: The Qianlong era produced many capable generals; these were the foremost among them.
